D1-001.q: Aap ko Microsoft Entra ID mein 25 users banane hain. Har user ko @contoso.com suffix ke sath sign in karna hai. Sab se PEHLE aap ko kya karna hoga?
opts: contoso.com naam ka Microsoft 365 group banayen
Tenant mein custom domain contoso.com add aur verify karein
Tamam 25 users ke liye Entra ID P1 licenses khareedein
Azure DNS mein contoso.com naam ka DNS zone banayen
D1-001.exp: UPN suffix tenant mein verified custom domain hona chahiye (jo aap ke registrar par TXT record se verify hota hai). Groups, licenses aur Azure DNS zones domain verify nahi karte.

D1-002.q: Ek user account 10 din pehle delete hua tha. Account ko us ki tamam properties aur group memberships ke sath wapas lane ka sab se aasan tareeqa kya hai?
opts: Usi UPN ke sath naya user banayen
Deleted users blade se user ko restore karein
Tenant ko backup se restore karein
User ko guest ke taur par dobara invite karein
D1-002.exp: 30 din ke andar soft-deleted users ko tamam properties aur memberships ke sath restore kiya ja sakta hai. Usi UPN wale naye user ko naya object ID milta hai aur koi membership nahi hoti; tenant restore jaisi koi cheez mojood nahi.

D1-003.q: Microsoft Entra ID delete kiye gaye user ko kitne din tak restore hone wali (soft-deleted) halat mein rakhta hai?
D1-003.exp: Jab aap user delete karte hain to Microsoft Entra ID usay Deleted users mein le jata hai aur 30 din tak rakhta hai. Is dauran aap usay tamam properties, group memberships aur licences ke sath restore kar sakte hain. 30 din ke baad woh hamesha ke liye delete ho jata hai aur wapas nahi aa sakta. 7, 14 aur 90 din Entra ID ka retention period nahi hain.

D1-004.q: Aap ek bahar ke consultant (anna@fabrikam.com) ko collaboration ke liye invite karte hain. Aap ke tenant mein us ke account ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: Aap ko us ke liye initial password set karna hoga
Woh apni organization ke credentials se authenticate karti hai; us ka userType Guest hai
Usay khud ba khud members jaisi default permissions mil jati hain
Usay sirf Microsoft 365 groups mein add kiya ja sakta hai, security groups mein nahi
D1-004.exp: B2B collaboration mein Anna apne Fabrikam account se sign in karti hai, is liye aap kabhi us ka password set ya manage nahi karte. Aap ke tenant mein us ka userType Guest hota hai, jis ki default permissions members se kam hoti hain. Guests ko security groups aur Microsoft 365 groups dono mein add kiya ja sakta hai.

D1-005.q: Kis group configuration ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P1 license zaroori hai?
opts: Dynamic user membership wala security group
SharePoint site share karne ke liye use hone wala group
D1-005.exp: Dynamic membership — jis mein Entra ID ek rule ke zariye users ya devices ko khud add aur remove karta hai — ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P1 licence chahiye. Assigned (manual) membership wale groups, chahe security hon ya Microsoft 365, Free tier par chalte hain, aur SharePoint site share karne ke liye P1 nahi chahiye.

D1-006.q: Aap rule user.department -eq "Sales" ke sath dynamic user group banate hain. Ek user ka department attribute "HR" se "Sales" kar diya jata hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Jab tak admin sync na chalaye kuch nahi hota
Rule process hone ke baad user khud ba khud group mein add ho jata hai
User ko group join karne ki email invitation milti hai
User sirf apne agle sign-in ke baad add hota hai
D1-006.exp: Jab bhi user ke attributes badalte hain, dynamic groups dobara evaluate hote hain. Jab department "Sales" ho jata hai to rule match karta hai aur Entra ID user ko khud add kar deta hai, aam tor par chand minute mein (bade tenants mein zyada waqt lag sakta hai). Admin sync, invitation ya sign-in ki zaroorat nahi.

D1-007.q: Kis qisam ke group mein devices members ho sakte hain?
D1-007.exp: Security groups mein users, devices, service principals aur doosre groups ho sakte hain, is liye device settings aur policies target karne ke liye inhi ko use kiya jata hai. Microsoft 365 groups aur distribution groups mein sirf users hote hain, kyun ke yeh collaboration aur email ke liye bane hain. Mail-enabled security groups mein bhi devices nahi aa sakte.

D1-008.q: Ek dynamic device group design kiya ja raha hai. Kaun si DO baatein sahi hain?
opts: Ek group ek hi waqt mein users aur devices dono ke liye dynamic membership use kar sakta hai
Ek group users YA devices ke liye dynamic membership rakh sakta hai, dono ke liye nahi
Dynamic membership rules deviceOSType jaisi device properties use kar sakte hain
Device objects sirf Microsoft 365 groups mein rakhe ja sakte hain
D1-008.exp: Dynamic group ka rule ya to users ko target karta hai ya devices ko, ek group mein dono kabhi nahi. Device rules deviceOSType, deviceOSVersion ya deviceOwnership jaisi device properties use kar sakte hain. Devices sirf security groups ke member ho sakte hain, Microsoft 365 groups ke nahi.

D1-009.q: Aap group-based licensing se group "Sales-Users" ko licenses assign karte hain. Ek user licensing error dikhata hai. Exam mein sab se aam wajah kaun si poochi jati hai?
opts: User ki usageLocation set nahi hai
D1-009.exp: Jin users ki usageLocation set nahi hoti un ke liye group-based licensing fail ho jati hai, kyun ke bohat si services sirf kuch regions mein milti hain. Guests ko license diya ja sakta hai, aur kai groups ke licenses aapas mein mil jate hain.

D1-010.q: Kaun se features ke liye P1 ke bajaye Microsoft Entra ID P2 chahiye?
opts: Privileged Identity Management (PIM) aur Identity Protection
On-premises writeback ke sath self-service password reset
D1-010.exp: Privileged Identity Management (just-in-time admin roles) aur Identity Protection (risk-based sign-in aur user policies) ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P2 chahiye, aur access reviews ke liye bhi. Conditional Access, dynamic groups aur on-premises writeback wale SSPR ke liye sirf P1 kaafi hai.

D1-011.q: Self-service password reset (SSPR) kis ke liye enable kiya ja sakta hai?
opts: Sirf tamam users ke liye — scoping mumkin nahi
None, selected groups, ya tamam users
Ek ek kar ke chune gaye individual users
Sirf Global Administrator role wale users
D1-011.exp: Entra ID → Password reset → Properties mein SSPR ko None (band), Selected (users ka ek group) ya All (har user) par set kiya ja sakta hai. Aap users ko ek ek kar ke nahi chun sakte; unhein ek group mein dal kar woh group select karte hain. SSPR sirf administrators tak mehdood nahi — balki yeh aam users ke liye hai taa ke unhein helpdesk ki zaroorat na pare.

D1-012.q: Aap ka hybrid environment on-premises AD se users sync karta hai. Jo users cloud mein password reset karein, un ka naya password on-premises AD mein wapas likhna zaroori hai. Aap ko kya chahiye?
opts: Entra ID P1 (ya us se upar) aur Entra Connect mein password writeback enabled
Sirf Entra ID P2, aur Entra Connect mein pass-through authentication enabled
D1-012.exp: Password writeback se cloud mein kiya gaya password reset on-premises AD mein wapas likha jata hai, taa ke wahi password domain PCs par bhi chale. Is ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P1 (ya upar) aur Entra Connect (ya Cloud Sync) mein password writeback option on hona chahiye. Free tier yeh nahi kar sakta, aur P2 zaroori nahi.

D1-013.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Guest user ko Entra ID administrative role assign kiya ja sakta hai
User ka userType banne ke baad Guest se Member kiya ja sakta hai
Ek security group doosre group ka owner ho sakta hai
User ka display name badalne se us ka sign-in name badal jata hai
D1-013.exp: Guests ko Entra admin roles diye ja sakte hain, aur aap baad mein user ka userType Guest se Member kar sakte hain. Group owners users ya service principals hone chahiye, groups nahi. Aur display name sirf ek label hai: usay edit karne se sign-in name (UPN) nahi badalta.

D1-014.q: Aap ko portal mein ek sath 200 users banane hain. Supported tareeqa kya hai?
opts: Users blade mein Bulk create operation ke zariye CSV file upload karein
Users blade mein JSON file upload karein
List ko New user form mein paste karein
PowerShell script chalana, kyunke portal ek waqt mein sirf ek user bana sakta hai
D1-014.exp: Users blade mein Bulk operations → Bulk create hota hai. Aap CSV template download karte hain, har user ki ek row bharte hain aur upload karte hain, aur Entra ID sab ko bana deta hai. JSON accept nahi hota, New user form ek waqt mein ek user banata hai, aur PowerShell ya CLI alternative hain, wahid option nahi.

D1-015.q: Management chahti hai ke aam (non-admin) users tenant mein applications register na kar sakein. Yeh kahan configure hota hai?
opts: Entra ID → Users → User settings → App registrations = No
Tenant root par Azure Policy assignment = Deny app registrations
D1-015.exp: "Users can register applications" tenant ki ek User setting hai. Conditional Access sign-in ki shartein control karta hai; RBAC aur Azure Policy Azure resources ko govern karte hain, directory ko nahi.

D1-016.q: Kaun sa option users ko apne personal Windows devices company directory se jorne deta hai jab ke device ki ownership personal hi rehti hai (BYOD scenario)?
D1-016.exp: Microsoft Entra registered personal (BYOD) devices ke liye hai: user device par apna personal account rakhta hai aur work account add karta hai, is tarah organization device ki malik bane baghair access manage kar sakti hai. Entra join company ke cloud-managed devices ke liye hai, aur hybrid join ya domain join on-premises AD wale company PCs ke liye.

D1-017.q: Kaun sa built-in role user ko resource group mein tamam resources banane aur manage karne deta hai lekin doosron ko access dene NAHI deta?
D1-017.exp: Contributor apne scope mein har qisam ka resource bana, badal aur delete kar sakta hai, lekin roles assign nahi kar sakta (us ke paas roleAssignments/write permission nahi). Owner doosron ko access bhi de sakta hai, User Access Administrator sirf access manage karta hai, aur Reader sirf dekh sakta hai.

D1-018.q: Kaun sa built-in role Azure resources tak user access manage kar sakta hai lekin khud resources bana ya badal nahi sakta?
D1-018.exp: User Access Administrator ke paas Microsoft.Authorization par poore rights hain, is liye woh role assignments bana aur hata sakta hai, lekin resources banane ya badalne ka koi right nahi. Owner dono kar sakta hai (resources aur access manage karna). Contributor is ka ulat hai: resources manage karta hai lekin access nahi de sakta. Security Admin Defender for Cloud ka role hai, access-management role nahi.

D1-019.q: Subscription scope par assign kiya gaya role kis par apply hota hai?
opts: Subscription aur us ke andar tamam resource groups aur resources par
Sirf assignment ke baad bane resource groups par
D1-019.exp: Azure RBAC neeche ki taraf inherit hota hai. Subscription par assign kiya gaya role khud subscription par aur us ke andar har resource group aur resource par apply hota hai, baad mein banne walon samet. Yeh upar nahi jata, is liye parent management group ya doosri subscriptions par kabhi apply nahi hota.

D1-020.q: Azure role assignment kin teen cheezon se banta hai?
D1-020.exp: Har role assignment teen sawalon ka jawab deta hai: kaun (security principal — user, group, service principal ya managed identity), kya (role definition, yani allowed actions ki list) aur kahan (scope — management group, subscription, resource group ya resource). Policies, licences aur passwords role assignment ka hissa nahi.

D1-021.q: User1 ke paas subscription Sub1 par Reader aur resource group RG1 (Sub1 ke andar) par Contributor hai. User1 RG1 mein kya kar sakta hai?
opts: Sirf resources parh sakta hai (Reader jeetta hai — sab se sakht)
Resources bana, badal aur delete kar sakta hai
Kuch nahi — takrane wale assignments ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain
Sirf woh actions jo dono roles mein common hain
D1-021.exp: Azure RBAC additive hai: user ki asal permissions us ke tamam role assignments ko mila kar banti hain. Subscription par Reader se User1 sab kuch dekh sakta hai, aur RG1 par Contributor wahan full management deta hai. 'Sab se sakht jeetta hai' jaisa koi rule nahi — sirf deny assignments permissions cheen sakti hain.

D1-022.q: Tenant ka Global Administrator subscription mein koi Azure resource nahi dekh sakta. Kyun?
opts: Entra ID roles aur Azure RBAC roles alag hain
Global Admins Azure resources se blocked hain
Unhein Entra ID P2 license chahiye
D1-022.exp: Microsoft Entra roles (jaise Global Administrator) directory control karte hain — users, groups aur settings. Azure RBAC roles (jaise Owner ya Reader) Azure resources control karte hain. Yeh alag systems hain, is liye Global Administrator ko subscriptions ka access tab tak nahi milta jab tak usay RBAC role na mile ya woh apna access elevate na kare.

D1-023.q: Ek Global Administrator ko orphaned access theek karne ke liye tenant ki TAMAM subscriptions manage karne ka waqti access chahiye. Supported tareeqa kya hai?
opts: Har subscription par ek ek kar ke Owner assign karein
"Access management for Azure resources" (elevate access) on karein
Microsoft.Authorization/* wala custom role bana kar tenant scope par assign karein
Access dene ke liye Azure Policy use karein
D1-023.exp: Global Administrator Entra properties mein 'Access management for Azure resources' on kar sakta hai. Is se woh root scope (/) par User Access Administrator ban jata hai, aur khud ko kisi bhi subscription ka access de sakta hai. Masla hal hone ke baad isay dobara off kar dein.

D1-024.q: Custom RBAC role ki kaun si property control karti hai ke role KAHAN assign ho sakta hai?
D1-024.exp: AssignableScopes batata hai ke custom role kahan assign ho sakta hai — kaun se management groups, subscriptions ya resource groups. Actions aur NotActions control-plane permissions define karte hain, aur DataActions data permissions, lekin in mein se koi yeh control nahi karta ke role kahan available hai.

D1-025.q: Ek custom role ko tamam read operations aur VMs restart karne ki ijazat deni hai, aur kuch nahi. Kaun sa Actions block sahi hai?
D1-025.exp: "*/read" har read operation ki ijazat deta hai, aur "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/restart/action" add karne se bilkul ek extra action milta hai. "*" ke sath NotActions "*/write" phir bhi deletes aur doosre actions allow karega, Microsoft.Compute/* compute par sab kuch allow karta hai, aur restart data action nahi hai.

opts: Aisa explicit deny banata hai jo user ke har doosre role par haawi hota hai
SIRF ussi role definition ke Actions mein se operations nikalta hai
User ko poore tenant mein block karta hai
Sirf built-in roles mein valid hai
D1-026.exp: NotActions sirf ussi role ki apni Actions list se operations hatata hai. Yeh deny nahi hai: agar user ke paas koi aur role assignment hai jo woh operation deta hai, to woh phir bhi kar sakta hai. Kisi operation ko har haal mein rokne ke liye deny assignment chahiye.

D1-027.q: Kaun se DO role assignments user ko doosre users ko resource group ka access dene dete hain?
opts: Resource group par User Access Administrator
D1-027.exp: Access dene ke liye user ke paas Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write hona chahiye. Owner aur User Access Administrator dono mein yeh shamil hai. Contributor mein yeh jaan boojh kar nikala gaya hai, aur subscription par Reader sirf read access deta hai.

D1-028.q: Kaun si CLI command user ali@contoso.com ko resource group RG1 par Reader role assign karti hai?
opts: az role assignment create --assignee ali@contoso.com --role Reader --resource-group RG1
az ad role assignment create --user ali@contoso.com --role Reader --group RG1
D1-028.exp: az role assignment create role assignment banati hai: --assignee kaun hai, --role kya hai, aur --resource-group (ya --scope) kahan hai. az role definition create role assign karne ke bajaye custom role banati hai, aur az ad role / az rbac grant asal commands nahi hain.

D1-029.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Management group scope par assign kiya gaya role us ke neeche ki tamam subscriptions mein inherit hota hai
User delete karne se us ke role assignments ka asar khatam ho jata hai, lekin assignment "Identity not found" ki surat mein baqi reh sakta hai
Administrator portal mein seedha deny assignment bana sakta hai
Azure RBAC role assignments Entra ID portal ke operations, jaise users banana, par apply hote hain
D1-029.exp: MG assignments inherit hote hain; orphaned assignments "Identity not found" dikhate hain; aap deny assignments seedhe nahi bana sakte — Azure unhein banata hai, maslan deployment stack ki deny settings se; directory operations ke liye Entra roles use hote hain, RBAC nahi.

D1-030.q: Group "Ops" ke paas management group "Corp" par Contributor hai. Sub1 "Corp" mein hai. User2 group "Ops" mein hai. Sub1 ke resource group RG5 par User2 ka asal role kya hai?
opts: Jab tak RG5 par seedha role assign na ho, koi access nahi
D1-030.exp: User2 Ops ka member hai, aur Ops ke paas Corp management group par Contributor hai. Group ko diye gaye role assignments us ke tamam members par apply hote hain, aur management group par assignments us ke neeche har subscription, resource group aur resource mein inherit hote hain. Is liye User2 ke paas baghair kisi direct assignment ke RG5 par Contributor hai.

D1-031.q: Ek user ko subscription ke liye sirf support tickets kholne ki ijazat honi chahiye, aur kuch nahi. Best-practice role kaun sa hai?
D1-031.exp: Support Request Contributor support requests bana aur manage kar sakta hai aur kuch nahi, is liye yeh least-privilege choice hai. Contributor aur Owner bohat zyada access dete hain, aur Billing Reader invoices aur billing data dekhne ke liye hai, support tickets ke liye nahi.

D1-032.q: Naye vendor ke engineer ko sirf RG-App mein VMs manage karne ka access dene ke steps sahi tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: RG-App scope par "Virtual Machine Contributor" role assign karein
Engineer ko Entra ID mein guest user ke taur par invite karein
Engineer invitation redeem karta hai
Guest ko security principal ke taur par select karein
D1-032.exp: Pehle engineer ko B2B guest ke taur par invite karein aur invitation redeem hone dein, taa ke guest aap ki directory mein mojood ho. Phir guest ko principal ke taur par select karein aur RG-App scope par Virtual Machine Contributor assign karein. Yeh role sirf VMs manage karta hai, aur scope usay ek resource group tak mehdood rakhta hai.

D1-033.q: Azure Policy aur Azure RBAC mein kya farq hai?
opts: Policy control karti hai ke resources ke sath KYA ho sakta hai (properties/compliance); RBAC control karta hai ke KAUN actions kar sakta hai
RBAC resources ki properties control karta hai; Policy yeh control karti hai ke kaun si identities tenant mein sign in kar sakti hain
Policy sirf users par apply hoti hai; RBAC sirf groups par
D1-033.exp: Azure Policy control karti hai ke resources kaise dikh sakte hain — allowed regions, SKUs, zaroori tags — chahe koi bhi deploy kare. RBAC control karta hai ke kaun kaun se actions kar sakta hai. Dono mil kar kaam karte hain: user ke paas sahi role ho tab bhi policy usay rok sakti hai.

D1-034.q: Aap ko kisi ko bhi West Europe ke ilawa kisi region mein virtual machines banane se rokna hai. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: "Allowed locations" definition wali Azure Policy, Deny effect ke sath assign ki hui
Custom RBAC role jis ki AssignableScopes property mein West Europe region ho
D1-034.exp: Built-in 'Allowed locations' policy Deny effect ke sath aap ke diye gaye regions ke ilawa har deployment block kar deti hai. Locks sirf delete ya changes rokte hain, NSGs network traffic filter karte hain, aur RBAC control karta hai ke kaun action kar sakta hai, yeh nahi ke resources kahan banen.

D1-035.q: Audit effect wali policy ek non-compliant resource dhoondti hai. Resource ke sath kya hota hai?
opts: Kuch nahi — usay sirf compliance reports mein non-compliant mark kiya jata hai
Agli 24 ghante wali compliance evaluation par khud theek ho jata hai
D1-035.exp: Audit effect sirf evaluate aur report karta hai. Non-compliant resource Policy compliance view mein non-compliant dikhaya jata hai aur Activity log entry likhi jati hai, lekin resource ko kuch nahi hota. Rokne ke liye Deny chahiye; theek karne ke liye Modify ya DeployIfNotExists remediation ke sath. Policy kabhi resources delete ya stop nahi karti.

D1-036.q: Kaun sa policy effect missing resource khud deploy kar sakta hai (maslan agar monitoring agent na ho to deploy kare), aur us ki remediation ko kya chahiye?
opts: DeployIfNotExists; managed identity use karne wala remediation task
Modify; service principal secret wala remediation task
D1-036.exp: DeployIfNotExists kisi related resource ya setting (jaise monitoring agent) ko check karta hai aur agar missing ho to deploy kar deta hai. Remediation tasks mojooda resources theek karte hain, aur dono policy assignment ki managed identity ke taur par chalte hain, jis ke paas sahi RBAC roles hone chahiye. Append aur Modify properties badalte hain, aur Deny requests rokta hai.

opts: Aisi policy definition jo assign hone ke baad badli nahi ja sakti
Policy definitions ka group jo ek unit ki tarah ek sath assign hota hai
Tenant root par assign ki gayi policy
D1-037.exp: Initiative (jise policy set bhi kehte hain) kai policy definitions ko group karta hai taa ke aap unhein ek unit ki tarah assign, parameterise aur compliance track kar sakein — maslan darjanon controls wala koi regulatory standard. Yeh badla ja sakta hai, kisi bhi scope par assign ho sakta hai, aur deny assignments se is ka koi taluq nahi.

D1-038.q: Public IP banana rokne wali policy subscription par assign hai. Ek resource group RG-Lab ko is se chhoot chahiye. BEHTAREEN tareeqa kya hai?
opts: RG-Lab ko doosre tenant mein move karein
Assignment par RG-Lab ko exclusion ke taur par add karein (ya policy exemption banayen)
RG-Lab par doosri policy assign karein jo public IPs allow kare, kyunke qareeb tareen scope jeetta hai
D1-038.exp: Policy assignments mein exclusions (scope evaluate nahi hota) aur exemptions (evaluate hota hai lekin Exempt mark hota hai, chahein to expiry ke sath) hote hain, is liye RG-Lab ko exclude karein ya us ke liye exemption banayen. Doosri 'allow' policy deny ko override nahi kar sakti, kyun ke tamam policies ek sath apply hoti hain. Tenant badalna ya policy delete karna zaroorat se zyada hai.

D1-039.q: Jo non-compliant resources Deny policy assign hone se PEHLE ban chuke the, un ke sath kya hota hai?
opts: Khud ba khud delete ho jate hain
Chalte rehte hain lekin non-compliant report hote hain
Khud ba khud stop ho jate hain
Quarantine resource group mein move ho jate hain
D1-039.exp: Deny policy sirf assignment ke baad aane wali create aur update requests rokti hai. Pehle se mojood resources delete, stop ya move nahi hote; agla compliance scan unhein sirf non-compliant mark karta hai taa ke aap unhein theek kar sakein. Mojooda resources khud badalne ke liye remediation task ke sath Modify ya DeployIfNotExists policy chahiye.

D1-040.q: Kaun sa lock type users ko resource parhne aur badalne deta hai lekin delete hone se rokta hai?
D1-040.exp: CanNotDelete lock (portal mein Delete dikhta hai) authorised users ko resource parhne aur badalne deta hai lekin delete karna block karta hai. ReadOnly lock zyada sakht hai: woh delete aur har change dono block karta hai. NoDelete aur Protect Azure lock types nahi hain.

D1-041.q: Ek storage account par ReadOnly lock lagaya gaya hai. Kaun sa ghair-mutawaqqa side effect exam mein aksar poocha jata hai?
opts: Storage Blob Data Reader role wale users ab blobs nahi parh sakte
Storage account keys list karne jaise operations fail ho jate hain, kyun ke list keys POST action hai
Account 30 din baad delete ho jata hai
D1-041.exp: ReadOnly lock control plane par sirf GET (read) requests allow karta hai. Storage account keys list karna POST operation (listKeys) hai, is liye woh fail hota hai — aur is se portal ke woh tools bhi toot jate hain jo data browse karne ke liye account keys use karte hain. Mojooda credentials se blobs parhna chalta rehta hai, aur kuch delete ya disable nahi hota.

D1-042.q: Resource group level par CanNotDelete lock lagaya gaya hai. Kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: Sirf resource group object mehfooz hai; andar ke resources delete ho sakte hain
Resource group ke andar tamam resources lock inherit karte hain aur delete nahi ho sakte
Lock 90 din baad expire ho jata hai
Owners lock hataye baghair bhi resources delete kar sakte hain
D1-042.exp: Locks inherit hote hain: resource group par CanNotDelete lock group aur us ke har resource ko bachata hai, baad mein add hone walon ko bhi. Locks expire nahi hote. Owner ko bhi kuch delete karne se pehle lock hatana parta hai.

D1-043.q: Kaun se roles management locks bana ya delete kar sakte hain?
D1-043.exp: Locks banane ya delete karne ke liye Microsoft.Authorization/locks/* permissions chahiye. Owner aur User Access Administrator ke paas yeh hain. Contributor aur Reader ke paas nahi, aur Global Administrator Entra role hai jis ke paas default mein Azure access nahi hota.

D1-044.q: Resource group RG1 par tag env=prod hai. VM1 RG1 ke andar banaya jata hai. VM1 par kaun sa tag hoga?
opts: env=prod, khud ba khud inherit hua
Koi tag nahi — default mein tags inherit nahi hote
RG1 se jorne wala system tag
D1-044.exp: Default mein tags inherit nahi hote. Resource group ke resources ko us ke tags khud nahi milte, is liye VM1 par koi tag nahi. Tags khud neeche copy karne ke liye built-in 'Inherit a tag from the resource group' policy use karein.

D1-045.q: Aap ko yaqeeni banana hai ke har NAYE resource ko us ke resource group se costcenter tag khud copy ho jaye. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Modify effect wali built-in Azure Policy "Inherit a tag from the resource group"
Built-in Azure Policy "Require a tag on resources", Audit effect ke sath
D1-045.exp: Built-in policy 'Inherit a tag from the resource group if missing' (ya 'Inherit a tag from the resource group') Modify effect se naye ya update hone wale resources par tag add karti hai. Remediation task isay mojooda resources par apply karta hai. Locks, templates aur Advisor tags copy nahi karte.

D1-046.q: Aap ek VM ko usi subscription mein RG1 se RG2 mein move karte hain. Kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: VM ka region RG2 ke region mein badal jata hai
VM ka region wahi rehta hai
Move ke dauran VM restart hota hai
VMs ko resource groups ke darmiyan move karna supported nahi
D1-046.exp: Resource ko resource groups ke darmiyan move karne se sirf us ka metadata badalta hai. VM ka region wahi rehta hai aur woh restart ke baghair chalta rehta hai. Move ke dauran dono resource groups create, update aur delete operations ke liye lock rehte hain.

D1-047.q: Management group hierarchy kitne levels gehri ho sakti hai (root management group aur subscriptions ko chhor kar)?
D1-047.exp: Management group tree zyada se zyada chhe levels gehra ho sakta hai. Tenant root management group aur subscription level in chhe mein nahi gine jate. Yeh platform ki fixed limit hai, is liye 'unlimited' ghalat hai.

D1-048.q: Aap "Corp" management group par ek policy aur root management group par user Bob ko RBAC Reader role assign karte hain. "Corp" ke neeche rakhi gayi nayi subscription Sub9 par kaun si baat apply hoti hai?
opts: Manually link karne tak koi bhi apply nahi hota
Dono inherit hote hain: Sub9 ko policy milti hai, aur Bob Sub9 ke resources parh sakta hai
Sirf RBAC inherit hota hai: Bob Sub9 parh sakta hai, lekin policy dobara assign karni hogi
Sirf policy inherit hoti hai, RBAC kabhi nahi
D1-048.exp: RBAC role assignments aur policy assignments dono hierarchy mein neeche inherit hote hain. Root par Bob ka Reader role har subscription par apply hota hai, aur Corp par policy Corp ke neeche har cheez par. Is liye Sub9 ko dono khud mil jate hain.

D1-049.q: Subscription par $500 ka monthly budget 80% par alert ke sath configure hai. Kharcha $500 tak pohanch jata hai. Chalte hue resources ka kya hota hai?
opts: Tamam resources khud ba khud deallocate ho jate hain
Kuch nahi — budgets alert karte hain lekin khud kabhi resources stop nahi karte
Agli billing period shuru hone tak nayi deployments block rehti hain
D1-049.exp: Budgets threshold pohanchne par sirf notifications (email ya action groups) bhejte hain. Woh khud kabhi resources stop ya deallocate nahi karte, deployments block nahi karte, aur subscription cancel nahi karte. Resources khud stop karne ke liye aisa action group lagayen jo runbook ya Logic App jaisi automation chalaye.

D1-050.ctx: Contoso ke paas management group MG-Prod hai jis mein Sub1 hai. Sub1 mein RG-Fin par CanNotDelete lock hai. MG-Prod par ek policy West Europe ke bahar resources banana deny karti hai. User1 ke paas Sub1 par Contributor hai.
D1-050.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: User1 RG-Fin mein East US mein storage account bana sakta hai
User1 RG-Fin ke andar VM delete kar sakta hai
User1 RG-Fin mein West Europe mein VM bana sakta hai
User1 RG-Fin se lock hata sakta hai
D1-050.exp: Policy West Europe ke ilawa creates deny karti hai; inherit hua CanNotDelete lock deletes block karta hai; Contributor + compliant region create ki ijazat deta hai; Contributor ke paas Microsoft.Authorization/locks permissions nahi.

D1-201.q: Requirement 1 poori karne ke liye aap ko kya banana chahiye?
opts: Sales department ke liye administrative unit
user.department par based dynamic user membership wala security group
Assigned membership wala security group, jo Logic App se update ho
D1-201.exp: user.department -eq "Sales" jaise rule wala dynamic user group members ko khud add aur remove karta hai. Contoso ke paas pehle se Entra ID P1 hai, jo dynamic groups ke liye zaroori hai. Logic App bhi kaam karega lekin administrative mehnat barhata hai.

D1-202.q: Kaun sa role assignment requirement 2 poori karta hai?
opts: Sub-Dev scope par User Access Administrator
D1-202.exp: Contributor har resource manage kar sakta hai lekin roles assign nahi kar sakta. Isay Sub-Dev tak scope karne se yeh sirf development tak mehdood rehta hai; MG-Contoso par Sub-Prod bhi aa jati. Owner aur User Access Administrator access de sakte hain.

D1-203.q: Requirement 3 poori karne ke liye statement mukammal karein.
D1-203.exp: Built-in Allowed locations policy (Deny) doosre regions block karti hai. Isay MG-Contoso par assign karne se ek hi assignment se dono subscriptions aur us management group ke neeche baad mein add hone wali har subscription cover ho jati hai.

D1-204.q: Requirement 4 poori karne ke liye aap ko kya configure karna chahiye?
opts: RG-Core par Deny effect wali Azure Policy
Tamam administrators se Owner role hata dein
D1-204.exp: RG-Core par CanNotDelete lock kisi ko bhi resource group ya us ke andar kuch bhi delete karne se rokta hai, jab ke changes ki ijazat rehti hai. ReadOnly lock configuration changes bhi block kar deta. Deny policy deletes control nahi karti, aur har Owner role hatane se admins apna kaam nahi kar payenge.

D1-205.q: Requirement 5 ke liye Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Contoso ki mojooda licensing password writeback support karti hai
Password writeback Microsoft Entra Connect mein enable hona chahiye
Writeback chalne ke liye security questions ko SSPR method ke taur par enable karna zaroori hai
Password writeback ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P2 chahiye
D1-205.exp: Writeback ke liye Entra ID P1 ya us se upar chahiye (Contoso ke paas P1 hai) aur isay Entra Connect aur Password reset settings mein enable karna hota hai. Yeh security questions par depend nahi karta, aur P2 zaroori nahi.

D1-206.q: Auditor ko access kaise dena chahiye (requirement 4)?
opts: auditor@fabrikam.com member account banayen aur Sub1 par Reader assign karein
Auditor ko B2B guest ke taur par invite karein aur Sub1 par Reader assign karein
Auditor ko B2B guest ke taur par invite karein aur Sub1 par Contributor assign karein
Audit ke dauran subscription owner ke credentials share karein
D1-206.exp: Auditor ko B2B guest ke taur par invite karein, taa ke woh apni organization ke account se sign in kare aur aap ko password manage na karna pare. Sub1 par Reader assign karein taa ke woh dekh sake lekin badal na sake. Member account ka matlab un ke credentials manage karna hoga, Contributor bohat zyada access deta hai, aur credentials share karna kabhi qabil-e-qabool nahi.

D1-207.q: WebOps ke liye role assignment mukammal karein (requirement 1).
D1-207.tpl: [[1]] tak scope kar ke [[0]] assign karein.
D1-207.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor WebOps ko VMs manage karne deta hai (banana, start, stop, resize) lekin un se jure virtual networks ya storage accounts nahi, aur yeh roles assign nahi kar sakta. Isay RG-Web scope par assign karne se WebOps doosre resource groups se bahar rehta hai.

D1-208.q: DBA team ko kaun sa role milna chahiye (requirement 2)?
D1-208.exp: Owner resources ka poora control deta hai aur team ko junior DBAs ko roles assign karne deta hai. Contributor roles assign nahi kar sakta; Sub1 scope par kuch bhi zaroorat se zyada wide hai.

D1-209.q: Finance ko kaun sa role milna chahiye (requirement 3)?
D1-209.exp: Cost Management Contributor resources manage kiye baghair costs dekh sakta hai aur budgets aur doosri cost configuration manage kar sakta hai. Billing Reader aur Reader budgets nahi bana sakte.

D1-210.q: Requirements 5 aur 6 ke liye Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: 80% alert condition wala budget threshold pohanchne par resources stop kar deta hai
Deny effect wali built-in policy "Require a tag on resource groups" requirement 6 poori karti hai
Resource group ke tags us ke andar ke resources khud ba khud inherit kar lete hain
Budget alert email bhejne ke sath action group bhi trigger kar sakta hai
D1-210.exp: Budgets sirf notify karte hain; kabhi resources stop nahi karte. Deny wali Require-a-tag policy tag ke baghair resource groups block karti hai. Default mein tags inherit nahi hote. Budget alerts action groups call kar sakte hain.

D1-211.q: Command mukammal karein taa ke user1 sirf resource group RG1 ke tamam resources dekh sake.
D1-211.exp: Reader sirf dekhne ka access deta hai. Resource group ka scope poora path /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/RG1 hai (aap --resource-group RG1 bhi use kar sakte hain). Subscription scope zaroorat se zyada wide hoga.

D1-212.q: Command mukammal karein taa ke koi RG1 delete na kar sake lekin changes ki ijazat rahe.
D1-212.exp: PowerShell, CLI aur API mein deletes rokne wale lock ko CanNotDelete kehte hain (portal mein 'Delete' dikhta hai). Is ke baad bhi resource group mein changes ho sakte hain. ReadOnly changes bhi rok deta.

D1-213.q: Har maqsad ke liye policy effect chunein.
D1-213.tpl:
Allowed na hone wale sizes ki VMs block karein: [[0]]
HTTPS-only ke baghair storage accounts sirf report karein: [[1]]
Resources bante ya update hote waqt missing tag add karein: [[2]]
D1-213.exp: Deny non-compliant requests rokta hai, Audit sirf report karta hai, aur Modify create ya update ke dauran tags jaisi properties add ya change karta hai. DeployIfNotExists ek related resource deploy karta hai.

D1-214.q: Har feature ke liye kam se kam licence chunein.
D1-214.tpl:
Dynamic membership groups: [[0]]
Privileged Identity Management: [[1]]
Conditional Access: [[2]]
D1-214.exp: Dynamic membership groups ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P1 chahiye, kyun ke group rules premium feature hain. Conditional Access ke liye bhi P1 chahiye. Privileged Identity Management (just-in-time, approval-based admin roles) ke liye P2 ya Entra ID Governance chahiye. Free edition mein na dynamic groups hain na Conditional Access.

D1-215.q: Custom role mukammal karein taa ke woh VMs dekh aur restart kar sake, aur ek subscription mein kahin bhi assign ho sake.
D1-215.exp: Read action se role VMs dekh sakta hai; restart action restart ki ijazat deta hai. Microsoft.Compute/* ya * is se kahin zyada de denge. Custom roles root scope "/" use nahi kar sakte; subscription ID ek valid assignable scope hai.

D1-216.tpl: Users se agle sign-in par un ke methods register karwane ke liye "Require users to register when signing in" ko [[0]] par set karein. Default mein users se har [[1]] din baad apni maloomat dobara confirm karwai jati hai.
D1-216.exp: 'Require users to register when signing in' ko Yes karne se users ko sign-in par apne SSPR methods register karne ka kaha jata hai. 'Number of days before users are asked to re-confirm their authentication information' ka default 180 din hai, is liye users saal mein do baar check karte hain ke un ki details ab bhi sahi hain.

D1-217.q: Dynamic membership rule mukammal karein taa ke Sales department ke woh users shamil hon jin ki licence usage location Pakistan hai.
D1-217.exp: department mein department ka naam hota hai. usageLocation licensing ke liye use hone wala do harfi country code (PK) hai. country attribute free text hota hai, jaise "Pakistan".

D1-218.q: Management group banane aur Sub1 ko us ke neeche rakhne wali commands mukammal karein.
D1-218.tpl:
az account management-group [[0]] --name MG-Prod
az account management-group subscription [[1]] --name MG-Prod --subscription Sub1
D1-218.exp: az account management-group create naya management group banati hai. Phir az account management-group subscription add subscription ko us ke neeche le jati hai. Subscription group ke RBAC assignments aur policies inherit kar leti hai.

D1-219.q: Command mukammal karein taa ke RG1 par env=prod add ho jaye aur us ke mojooda tags na hatein.
D1-219.exp: az tag update --operation Merge aap ke diye gaye tags add ya update karta hai aur baqi har tag rakhta hai. Replace list mein na hone wala har tag hata deta, aur Delete diye gaye tags hata deta hai.

D1-220.tpl: Aam members ko guests invite karne se rokne ke liye [[1]] mein [[0]] badlein.
D1-220.exp: Kaun guests invite kar sakta hai, yeh Microsoft Entra ID → External Identities → External collaboration settings mein, Guest invite settings ke neeche set hota hai. Aap kisi ko bhi, sirf members ko, sirf admins aur Guest Inviter role ko, ya kisi ko bhi nahi ijazat de sakte hain.

D1-221.q: Har requirement ko us Azure feature se match karein jo usay poora karta hai.
items: Costs ko department ke hisaab se organise karna
Resource group ko delete hone se rokna
Ek sath bohat si subscriptions par governance apply karna
Resources kaun se regions use kar sakte hain, yeh mehdood karna
D1-221.exp: Tags costs ko group karte hain; locks delete hone se rokte hain; management groups inherited governance ke liye subscriptions organise karte hain; Azure Policy location jaisi properties mehdood karti hai.

D1-222.q: Har description ko built-in role se match karein.
items: Resources manage karna lekin access nahi
Access manage karna lekin resources nahi
Sirf dekhna
Resources aur access dono manage karna
D1-222.exp: Contributor tamam resources manage karta hai lekin access nahi de sakta. User Access Administrator access manage karta hai lekin resources nahi. Reader sirf dekh sakta hai. Owner dono kar sakta hai — resources manage karna aur access dena.

D1-223.q: Har feature ko kam se kam Microsoft Entra licence se match karein.
items: Conditional Access
Privileged Identity Management
Group-based licensing
Basic user aur group management
Risk-based policies (Identity Protection)
D1-223.exp: Conditional Access aur group-based licensing ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P1 chahiye. Privileged Identity Management aur Identity Protection ki risk-based policies ke liye P2 chahiye. Basic user aur group management Free tier mein shamil hai.

D1-224.q: Har device ko sahi Microsoft Entra device identity se match karein.
items: Company ka PC jo pehle se on-premises AD se joined hai
Employee ka personal Android phone
Naya company laptop, sirf cloud
D1-224.exp: On-premises AD se pehle se joined company PC Microsoft Entra hybrid joined banta hai, taa ke dono usay jaanein. Employee ka personal phone Microsoft Entra registered (BYOD) hai. Naya cloud-only company laptop Microsoft Entra joined hai.

D1-225.q: Har behaviour ko Azure Policy effect se match karein.
items: Request block karta hai
Sirf non-compliance report karta hai
Deployment ke dauran properties badalta hai
Related resource missing ho to deploy karta hai
D1-225.exp: Deny non-compliant create ya update request block karta hai. Audit usay hone deta hai lekin non-compliant report karta hai. Modify deployment ke dauran properties (jaise tags) add ya change karta hai. DeployIfNotExists main resource banne ke baad missing related resource deploy karta hai.

D1-226.q: Har kaam ko least-privileged Microsoft Entra role se match karein.
items: App registrations manage karna
Tenant ka poora control
Non-admin users ke passwords reset karna
Users aur groups banana
D1-226.exp: Application Administrator apps manage karta hai; Global Administrator ke paas poora control hai; Helpdesk Administrator non-admin passwords reset karta hai; User Administrator users aur groups banata hai.

D1-227.q: Har description ko identity type se match karein.
items: Invite kiya gaya bahar ka shakhs
Apne Azure resource ke sath khud delete ho jati hai
Alag resource hai aur kai resources share kar sakte hain
D1-227.exp: Guests invite kiye gaye bahar ke users hain. System-assigned identity ki zindagi us ke resource ke sath hoti hai. User-assigned identity apna alag resource hai aur kai resources se attach ho sakti hai.

D1-228.q: Har zaroorat ko cost tool se match karein.
items: Idle VMs ke liye right-sizing recommendations lena
Pichle mahine ka asal kharcha analyse karna
Planned deployment ki cost ka andaza lagana
On-premises costs ka Azure se muqabla karna
D1-228.exp: Advisor bachat ki recommendations deta hai; Cost analysis asal kharcha dikhata hai; pricing calculator naye deployments ka andaza lagata hai; TCO calculator on-premises ka Azure se muqabla karta hai.

D1-229.q: user1 Ops-Group ka member hai. user1 resource group RG2 (usi subscription mein) mein kya kar sakta hai?
opts: Resources bana, badal aur delete kar sakta hai
Doosre users ko roles assign kar sakta hai
D1-229.exp: RG2 mein sirf subscription scope par Reader assignment apply hota hai, jo har resource group mein inherit hota hai, is liye user1 dekh sakta hai lekin kuch badal nahi sakta. Contributor assignment sirf RG1 par apply hota hai. Koi bhi role user1 ko roles assign karne nahi deta.

D1-230.q: Custom role dekhein. Jis user ke paas SIRF yeh role hai us ke liye Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: User storage accounts bana sakta hai
User storage accounts delete kar sakta hai
User Microsoft Entra authorisation se blob contents parh sakta hai
Yeh role subscription 1111 ke resource group par assign ho sakta hai
D1-230.exp: storageAccounts/* mein write (create aur update) shamil hai, lekin NotActions delete nikal deta hai. Koi DataActions nahi, is liye blob data ka access nahi. Assignable subscription ke andar resource group ek valid scope hai.

D1-231.q: Yeh policy allowedLocations = ["westeurope", "northeurope"] ke sath ek subscription par assign hai. Jab koi East US mein VM deploy kare to kya hota hai?
opts: VM ban jati hai aur non-compliant flag hoti hai
VM ban jati hai aur West Europe mein move ho jati hai
VM ban jati hai aur allowed locations ke tag lag jate hain
D1-231.exp: Policy rule har us resource ko match karta hai jis ki location allowed list mein nahi, aur Deny effect lagata hai. East US [westeurope, northeurope] mein nahi, is liye deployment request kuch banne se pehle hi reject ho jati hai. Is case mein Policy kabhi resources move ya tag nahi karti.

D1-232.q: Wahi deny policy aaj assign ki gayi hai. Pichle mahine East US mein ek storage account bana tha. Us ka kya hota hai?
opts: Agle evaluation par delete ho jata hai
Chalta rehta hai aur non-compliant report hota hai
Khud ba khud West Europe mein move ho jata hai
D1-232.exp: Deny sirf naye create aur update requests rokta hai. Mojooda resources phir bhi evaluate hote hain aur compliance report mein non-compliant dikhte hain, lekin Azure Policy unhein delete, stop ya move nahi karti. Unhein aap ko khud theek karna hoga (Deny ki koi remediation nahi).

D1-233.q: Yeh Bicep file resource group RG-Prod par deploy hoti hai. Phir ek administrator RG-Prod mein App Service plan scale out karne ki koshish karta hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Scale-out kamyab hota hai kyun ke locks sirf deletion rokte hain
Scale-out fail hota hai kyun ke ReadOnly tamam write operations block karta hai
Scale-out sirf Owners ke liye kamyab hota hai
Lock khud ba khud hat jata hai
D1-233.exp: Resource group scope par ReadOnly lock us ke har resource par apply hota hai aur lock hatne tak har kisi ke liye tamam write operations, scaling samet, block karta hai.

D1-234.q: Is dynamic rule wale group ka member kaun sa user banta hai?
D1-234.exp: Rule -or use karta hai, is liye dono mein se koi bhi shart poori karne wala user join karta hai. -contains substring match hai, is liye jobTitle "Senior Engineer" mein "Engineer" hai aur match hota hai. Department wali shart -eq use karti hai, jo bilkul exact match mangti hai, is liye "IT Operations" "IT" ke barabar nahi.

D1-235.q: Yeh Log Analytics query kya return karti hai?
opts: Tenant mein har nakaam sign-in, user ke naam aur IP address ke sath
Kamyab role assignment creations, kis ne aur kahan banaye
D1-235.exp: Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write woh operation hai jo koi role assignment banane par record hota hai. Query sirf kamyab wale rakhti hai aur waqt, caller (kis ne kiya) aur resource group dikhati hai. Is mein sign-ins, mojooda role holders ya lock hatana shamil nahi.

D1-236.q: Hierarchy aur us ke assignments dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Allowed locations policy Sub-Dev par apply hoti hai
Ops-Group Sub-Dev mein resources bana sakta hai
Ops-Group Sub-Prod mein West Europe mein resources bana sakta hai
MG-Prod ke neeche move ki gayi nayi subscription ko policy aur role assignment dono milte hain
D1-236.exp: Policy aur RBAC assignments hierarchy mein neeche inherit hote hain. MG-Corp ki policy dono subscriptions tak pohanchti hai. Ops-Group ka Contributor role sirf MG-Prod par hai, is liye yeh Sub-Prod aur baad mein MG-Prod ke neeche rakhi jane wali har subscription ko cover karta hai.

D1-237.q: 1,000 USD ke monthly budget mein yeh notifications hain. Asal kharcha 600 USD hai, lekin Azure mahine ke liye 1,150 USD ka forecast karta hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: Jab tak asal kharcha 800 USD se upar na jaye kuch nahi
Email bheji jati hai kyun ke forecasted kharcha budget ke 100% se zyada hai
Forecast 1,000 USD se upar jane par resources stop ho jate hain
Dono notifications sirf mahine ke aakhir mein fire hoti hain
D1-237.exp: Forecasted notification tab hi fire ho jati hai jab Azure andaza lagaye ke period ke aakhir tak kharcha threshold tak pohanch jayega, chahe asal kharcha kam ho. 1,150 USD ka forecast 1,000 USD budget ke 100% se zyada hai, is liye email abhi chali jati hai. Budgets kabhi resources stop nahi karte.

D1-238.q: Yeh command chalne ke baad group ke members kya kar sakte hain?
opts: RG-App mein VMs manage kar sakte hain, lekin un se jure virtual networks nahi, aur roles assign nahi kar sakte
RG-App ka har resource manage kar sakte hain
RG-App mein VMs aur un ke virtual networks manage karna, aur doosron ko VM roles assign karna
RG-App mein sirf VMs start aur stop kar sakte hain
D1-238.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor group ko VMs manage karne deta hai — banana, start, stop, resize aur delete — lekin VMs ke istemal wale virtual networks ya storage accounts nahi, aur yeh roles assign nahi kar sakta. Command ka scope RG-App hai, is liye yeh doosre resource groups par apply nahi hota.

D1-239.q: User list dekhein. Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Sara apne Fabrikam credentials se sign in karti hai
Bilal sign in kar sakta hai
Usage location set hone tak Sara ke liye group-based licensing fail hogi
Ali ko licence assign kiya ja sakta hai
D1-239.exp: Sara B2B guest hai, is liye woh apni home organization se authenticate karti hai. Bilal ka account disabled hai. Licences ke liye usage location chahiye, jo Sara ki nahi. Ali ki hai.

D1-240.q: Is policy assignment mein managed identity kyun shamil hai?
opts: Policy assignments ko hamesha identity chahiye
Modify effect ko remediation ke zariye mojooda resources ke tags badalne ke liye identity chahiye
Resource group se tag ki value parhne ke liye identity chahiye
Modify effect ko identity is liye chahiye ke remediation ke dauran resource locks bypass kar sake
D1-240.exp: "Inherit a tag from the resource group" Modify effect use karti hai. Remediation tasks assignment ki managed identity ban kar mojooda resources badalte hain, jis ke paas Tag Contributor jaisa role hona chahiye.

D1-051.q: Har naye Microsoft Entra tenant ko kis format ka default domain name milta hai?
D1-051.exp: Har naye tenant ko <name>.onmicrosoft.com format ka initial domain milta hai, jise hataya nahi ja sakta. Aap contoso.com jaise custom domains upar se add karte hain aur DNS record se verify karte hain. azurewebsites.net aur cloudapp.net App Service aur cloud services use karti hain, Entra ID nahi.

D1-052.q: Aap contoso.com ko custom domain ke taur par add karte hain. Ownership verify karne ke liye registrar par kaun sa DNS record banayenge?
opts: Entra ki di hui value wala TXT (ya MX) record
Entra ID ki taraf point karta A record
CNAME record jo login.microsoftonline.com ki taraf ishara kare
D1-052.exp: Yeh sabit karne ke liye ke contoso.com aap ka hai, Entra ID aap ko ek unique value deta hai jo DNS mein TXT record ke taur par publish karni hoti hai (MX record bhi chalta hai). Entra ID record dhoond kar domain ko verified mark kar deta hai. A, CNAME aur SRV records services ki taraf point karte hain; is process mein ownership sabit nahi karte.

D1-053.q: Microsoft Entra user ka asal sign-in name kaun sa attribute hai?
D1-053.exp: userPrincipalName (UPN), name@domain format mein, woh hai jo user sign in ke liye type karta hai. displayName sirf lists mein dikhne wala naam hai, mailNickname email alias hai, aur employeeId HR attribute hai. Display name badalne se user ka sign-in kabhi nahi badalta.

D1-054.q: Scripts se Entra users manage karne ke liye Microsoft ka mojooda recommended PowerShell module kaun sa hai?
D1-054.exp: AzureAD aur MSOnline modules retire ho chuke hain. Microsoft Graph PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph module, New-MgUser aur Update-MgUser jaise cmdlets ke sath) supported replacement hai. Az.Accounts Azure sign-in handle karta hai, Entra user management nahi.

D1-055.q: Kaun si Azure CLI command naya Entra user banati hai?
D1-055.exp: Entra ID objects az ad ke neeche manage hote hain. az ad user create ko kam az kam --display-name, --user-principal-name aur --password chahiye. az user, az entra aur az account user users banane ke liye valid command groups nahi hain.

D1-056.q: Ek user 45 din pehle permanently delete hua tha. Account wapas lane ke liye aap kya kar sakte hain?
opts: Deleted users blade se restore karein
Kuch nahi — 30 din ke baad user permanently delete ho jata hai; naya account banayen
Usi object ID ke sath restore karwane ke liye support ticket kholein
az ad user restore use karein
D1-056.exp: Deleted users 30 din tak Deleted users mein rehte hain, jis dauran aap unhein sab kuch samet restore kar sakte hain. 30 din ke baad woh permanently delete ho jate hain aur wapas nahi aa sakte — support bhi nahi la sakta. Aap ko naya account banana hoga.

D1-057.q: Users Entra Connect ke zariye on-premises Active Directory se sync hote hain. Synced user ka job title kahan badalna hoga?
D1-057.exp: Entra Connect se on-premises AD se sync hone wale users ke liye on-premises AD source of authority hai. Job title jaise attributes wahan badlein, aur change Entra ID mein sync ho jata hai. Entra admin center mein kiye gaye edits block ya overwrite ho jayenge.

D1-058.q: Naye tenant mein ek aam member user default mein kaun se DO kaam kar sakta hai?
opts: Billing ke baghair tenant mein Azure subscriptions banana
D1-058.exp: Default mein member users applications register kar sakte hain aur guests invite kar sakte hain; admins dono ko user settings aur external collaboration settings mein band kar sakte hain. Members Entra admin roles assign nahi kar sakte, aur subscriptions banane ke liye billing account ya offer chahiye.

D1-059.q: Aap ko account delete kiye baghair user ka sign-in foran block karna hai. Aap kya karenge?
opts: 'Account enabled' (block sign-in) ko No par set karein
Unhein tamam groups aur directory roles se nikalein
Us ka display name badal dein
D1-059.exp: 'Account enabled' ko No karne (sign-in block karne) se user foran authenticate nahi kar pata, jab ke account, group memberships, licences aur data baqi rehte hain. Licences ya groups hatane se sign-in nahi rukta, aur display name badalne ka access par koi asar nahi.

D1-060.q: Kaun sa built-in Entra role sab se kam privilege wala hai jo users bana sake, non-admins ke passwords reset kar sake aur groups manage kar sake?
D1-060.exp: User Administrator users aur groups manage karta hai aur non-admin passwords reset kar sakta hai. Helpdesk Administrator sirf kuch mehdood roles ke passwords reset kar sakta hai; users nahi bana sakta.

D1-061.q: Helpdesk team ko sirf non-administrator users ke passwords reset karne hain. Least-privilege Entra role kaun sa hai?
D1-061.exp: Password Administrator aur Helpdesk Administrator non-administrators (aur kuch mehdood admin roles) ke passwords reset kar sakte hain, aur helpdesk ko bas yahi chahiye. User Administrator users bana aur manage bhi kar sakta hai, Global Administrator sab kuch kar sakta hai, aur Privileged Authentication Administrator admins samet kisi bhi user ka password reset kar sakta hai.

D1-062.q: Aap ke users kin bahar ke domains se guests invite kar sakte hain, yeh kahan mehdood karte hain?
D1-062.exp: External collaboration settings mein collaboration restrictions hain, jahan aap sirf kuch khaas domains ko invitations allow (allow list) ya kuch domains ko block (deny list) kar sakte hain. Conditional Access aur named locations sign-in ki shartein control karte hain, aur Azure Policy resources control karti hai.

D1-063.q: Aap chahte hain ke sirf admins aur Guest Inviter role wale users guests invite kar sakein. Yeh kahan configure hota hai?
opts: External collaboration settings → Guest invite settings
Password reset properties → Guest invite restrictions
D1-063.exp: External collaboration settings ke neeche Guest invite settings control karti hain ke kaun guests invite kar sakta hai: koi bhi, member users, sirf admin roles aur Guest Inviter role wale users, ya koi nahi. App registrations, password reset aur device settings invitations control nahi karte.

D1-064.q: B2B collaboration se invite hone par guest ko kya milta hai?
opts: Aap ke tenant mein naya mailbox
Kuch nahi — access baghair kisi action ke foran mil jata hai
D1-064.exp: B2B guests ko invitation email (ya direct link) milti hai aur woh apne account se sign in kar ke aur aap ke tenant ki permissions par consent de kar usay redeem karte hain. Aap unhein kabhi password nahi bhejte, unhein aap ke tenant mein mailbox nahi milta, aur redeem karne tak un ka status pending dikhta hai.

D1-065.q: Aap ko ek sath 300 partner users invite karne hain. Portal mein sab se kam mehnat wala tareeqa kaun sa hai?
opts: Har user ko alag alag invite karein
Users blade mein CSV file se Bulk invite karein
Unhein naye passwords ke sath members ke taur par banayen
D1-065.exp: Users → Bulk operations → Bulk invite ek CSV file leta hai jis mein har guest ka email address aur optional message hota hai, aur tamam B2B invitations ek sath bhej deta hai. Passwords wale member accounts banane se bahar ke logon ko andar ke accounts mil jayenge, jo B2B ka maqsad hi khatam kar deta hai, aur Azure Policy users manage nahi karti.

D1-066.q: B2B guests ke bare mein har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Guest ko security group mein add kiya ja sakta hai
Guest ko resource group par Azure RBAC role assign kiya ja sakta hai
Invite hone ke liye guest ke paas Entra ID P2 license hona zaroori hai
Guest invitation ka status 'Pending acceptance' ho sakta hai
D1-066.exp: Guests ko members ki tarah security groups mein add kiya ja sakta hai aur Azure RBAC roles diye ja sakte hain. Guests invite karne ke liye P2 licence nahi chahiye. Jab tak guest apni invitation redeem na kare, us ka status 'Pending acceptance' dikhta hai.

D1-067.q: Default mein guests members ke muqable mein aap ki directory mein kitna dekh sakte hain?
opts: Mehdood — woh users ki aur apne groups ki kuch properties dekh sakte hain
Kuch bhi nahi — woh apni profile ya apni group memberships bhi nahi dekh sakte
D1-067.exp: Default mein guests ka directory access mehdood hota hai: woh apna profile aur doosre users aur apne groups ki kuch details dekh sakte hain, lekin members ki tarah poori directory browse nahi kar sakte. External collaboration settings mein aap guest access ko zyada ya kam sakht kar sakte hain.

D1-068.q: Kaun sa group type members ko shared mailbox, calendar aur SharePoint site deta hai?
D1-068.exp: Microsoft 365 group apne members ko shared collaboration tools deta hai: mailbox, calendar, SharePoint site, Planner aur Teams integration. Security group sirf access aur policies ke liye hai, aur distribution list sirf email bhejti hai.

D1-069.q: Device configuration target karne ke liye aap ko aisa group chahiye jis ke members tamam Windows 11 devices hon. Kaun se DO choices mil kar zaroori hain?
D1-069.exp: Devices sirf security groups ke member ho sakte hain, aur dynamic device membership har us device ko add karti hai jo rule se match kare, jaise Windows 11 (deviceOSType aur deviceOSVersion). Microsoft 365 groups mein devices nahi ho sakte, aur dynamic user rule devices ke bajaye users add karega.

D1-070.q: Kaun sa rule sahi tarah un users ko chunta hai jin ka department Sales AUR country Pakistan hai?
D1-070.exp: Dynamic membership rules (user.property -operator "value") syntax use karte hain, exact match ke liye -eq aur shartein jorne ke liye -and / -or. Rule ko Sales AUR Pakistan dono match karne hain, is liye -and chahiye; -or wala option Pakistan ke har user ko bhi shamil kar lega. =, == aur && jaise operators rules mein valid nahi.

D1-071.q: Aap 40 manually add kiye gaye members wale group ko Assigned se Dynamic user membership mein badalte hain. Un members ka kya hota hai?
opts: Woh hamesha static members rehte hain
Membership rule se dobara calculate hoti hai
Jab tak group mein members hain change block rehta hai
Woh guests mein badal jate hain
D1-071.exp: Jab group dynamic membership use karne lage to rule hi members ka wahid source hota hai. Entra ID rule se membership dobara calculate karta hai, is liye manually add kiye gaye jo members match nahi karte woh nikal jate hain. Change block nahi hota, aur koi guest mein nahi badalta.

D1-072.q: Dynamic security group ka owner ek user ko manually add karne ki koshish karta hai. Kya hota hai?
opts: User 24 ghante ke liye add hota hai
Rule khud ba khud disable ho jata hai
D1-072.exp: Dynamic group mein rule membership ka faisla karta hai, is liye owners bhi manually members add ya remove nahi kar sakte. User ko shamil karne ke liye rule ya user ke attributes (jaise department) badlein taa ke woh match kare.

D1-073.q: Microsoft Entra security group ka owner kaun ho sakta hai?
D1-073.exp: Group owners users ya service principals (applications) ho sakte hain. Owner group ke members aur settings manage kar sakta hai. Groups aur devices owners nahi ho sakte, aur group ka owner banne ke liye Global Administrator hona zaroori nahi.

D1-074.q: Aap chahte hain ke users sirf tab Microsoft 365 groups banayen jab woh group 'GroupCreators' ke member hon. Yeh kaise hota hai?
opts: Group creation restriction setting (Graph/PowerShell directory setting) jo sirf us group ko allow kare
Conditional Access policy jo Groups service ko target kare aur sirf GroupCreators ko shamil kare
Baqi sab ko Groups Administrator role assign karein
D1-074.exp: Microsoft 365 group banana directory setting EnableGroupCreation / GroupCreationAllowedGroupId ke zariye ek makhsoos security group ke members tak mehdood kiya ja sakta hai.

D1-075.q: Aap chahte hain ke agar 180 din baad koi Microsoft 365 groups renew na kare to woh khud delete ho jayen. Aap kya configure karenge?
D1-075.exp: Group expiration policy Microsoft 365 groups ko ek umar deti hai, jaise 180 din. Owners ko renewal emails milti hain, aur jin groups ko koi renew na kare woh delete ho jate hain (aur 30 din tak restore ho sakte hain). Active groups khud renew ho jate hain. Naming policies naam control karti hain, aur access reviews membership check karte hain.

D1-076.q: Delete kiya gaya Microsoft 365 group kitne arse tak restore ho sakta hai?
D1-076.exp: Delete kiye gaye Microsoft 365 groups 30 din tak soft-deleted rehte hain, jis dauran aap unhein mailbox, files aur members samet restore kar sakte hain. 30 din ke baad woh permanently hat jate hain. (Security groups soft-delete nahi hote — woh foran delete ho jate hain.)

D1-077.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Security group mein doosra security group ho sakta hai
Microsoft 365 group mein device ho sakta hai
Dynamic group processing foran hoti hai
Dynamic group ke members ke liye Entra ID P1 zaroori hai
D1-077.exp: Security groups mein doosre security groups ho sakte hain (nesting). Microsoft 365 groups mein sirf users hote hain, devices nahi. Dynamic membership background mein process hoti hai aur minute ya zyada le sakti hai. Dynamic groups ke users ke liye Entra ID P1 chahiye.

D1-078.q: Nested groups ke bare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?
opts: Group-based licensing tamam nested members par apply hoti hai
Nested group ke members ko parent group ko diye gaye licenses NAHI milte
Dynamic groups default mein rules ke zariye doosre groups ko members bana sakte hain
D1-078.exp: Group-based licensing sirf group ke direct members par apply hoti hai. Nested group ke members ko parent group se licence nahi milta. Dynamic membership rules user ya device attributes match karte hain, doosre groups nahi, aur security groups mein nesting supported hai.

D1-079.q: Kaun si Azure CLI command user ko group mein add karti hai?
opts: az ad group member add --group G1 --member-id <objectId>
D1-079.exp: az ad group member add Entra group mein member add karti hai, --group (naam ya ID) aur --member-id (user, group ya service principal ka object ID) ke sath. az group commands Azure resource groups manage karti hain, Entra groups nahi, aur az role assignment create group membership ke bajaye Azure roles deti hai.

D1-080.q: User ko license assign karne se pehle kaun si property set honi chahiye?
D1-080.exp: Licence assign karne se pehle user ki usageLocation (do harfi country code) set honi chahiye, kyun ke kuch services har mulk mein available nahi. Job title, department aur manager optional hain aur licensing par asar nahi dalte.

D1-081.q: Aap ke paas 100 P1 licenses hain aur aap unhein 110 members wale group ko assign karte hain. Kya hota hai?
opts: Tamam 110 ko licenses mil jate hain
Azure khud 10 aur licenses khareed leta hai
D1-081.exp: Group-based licensing sirf tab tak licences assign karti hai jab tak woh available hon. Pehle 100 members ko P1 milta hai; baqi 10 group ke licence view mein licence error ('not enough licences') dikhate hain. Azure kabhi khud licences nahi khareedta, aur kami ki wajah se baqi 100 ka licence nahi rukta.

D1-082.q: Ek user ke paas wahi license direct bhi assign hai aur group se bhi inherit hua hai. Aap usay group se nikal dete hain. Kya hota hai?
opts: Direct assignment ki wajah se license baqi rehta hai
Hatne tak user ke paas do licenses rehte hain
D1-082.exp: User ke paas wahi licence direct aur group dono se ho sakta hai, aur dono assignments alag alag track hote hain. Group membership hatane se sirf inherited assignment hatta hai; direct wala licence active rakhta hai. User delete nahi hota aur do licences use nahi karta.

D1-083.q: Aap group ko Microsoft 365 E3 assign karte hain lekin sirf usi group ke liye Exchange Online service plan band karna hai. Kaise?
opts: Group ka license assignment edit karein aur woh makhsoos service plan off karein
Conditional Access policy banayen jo group ke liye Exchange Online block kare
D1-083.exp: Jab aap Microsoft 365 E3 jaisa product group ko assign karte hain, to aap us ke andar alag alag service plans (maslan Exchange Online) sirf us group ke liye band kar sakte hain. Members ko baqi product milta hai. Conditional Access sign-in control karta hai, licences nahi, aur poore tenant se Exchange hatane se sab par asar parega.

D1-084.q: Kaun si edition har Azure subscription ke sath baghair extra cost ke shamil hoti hai?
D1-084.exp: Har Azure, Microsoft 365 aur Dynamics 365 subscription mein Microsoft Entra ID Free shamil hai: users, groups, basic SSO aur security defaults. P1, P2 aur Entra ID Governance paid add-ons hain jin mein Conditional Access, PIM aur access reviews jaise features hain.

D1-085.q: Kis feature ke liye Entra ID P2 chahiye?
opts: Cloud users ke liye self-service password reset
D1-085.exp: Access reviews — baqaidagi se check karna ke kis ko ab bhi group membership, app access ya roles chahiye — ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P2 (ya ID Governance) chahiye, PIM aur Identity Protection ki tarah. Cloud users ke liye SSPR tamam tiers mein shamil hai, aur group-based licensing aur Conditional Access ke liye P1 chahiye.

D1-086.q: Aap ko MFA sirf tab require karna hai jab Identity Protection koi risky sign-in detect kare. Kaun sa license chahiye?
opts: Koi license nahi — security defaults yeh kar dete hain
D1-086.exp: Risk-based Conditional Access ('sign-in risk medium ya high ho to MFA require karo') Microsoft Entra ID Protection par chalta hai, jo P2 feature hai. P1 risk signals ke baghair aam Conditional Access deta hai. Security defaults sab ke liye MFA on karte hain lekin risk par react nahi kar sakte, aur Free mein Identity Protection shamil nahi.

D1-087.q: SSPR mein administrator reset se pehle user se kitne authentication methods require kar sakta hai?
D1-087.exp: Password reset → Authentication methods mein 'Number of methods required to reset' ko 1 ya 2 par set kiya ja sakta hai. Do methods zyada mehfooz hain. Is se zyada tadaad ka option nahi, aur yeh 1 par fixed bhi nahi.

D1-088.q: Administrator accounts ke liye kaun sa SSPR method KABHI allowed nahi?
D1-088.exp: Administrators par hamesha sakht reset policy lagti hai: unhein do methods use karne hote hain, aur admin accounts ke liye security questions kabhi allowed nahi kyun ke jawab andaza lagana ya dhoondna aasan hai. App notification, email aur phone (SMS) admins ke liye available rehte hain.

D1-089.q: SSPR 'Selected' par set hai. Aap kitne groups chun sakte hain?
opts: Ek group (jis mein nested groups ho sakte hain)
D1-089.exp: Selected option mein aap portal mein bilkul ek group chun sakte hain. Zyada logon ko shamil karne ke liye unhein usi group mein add karein ya doosre groups us ke andar nest karein. 10 groups ka option nahi, aur group ka dynamic hona zaroori nahi.

D1-090.q: Aap chahte hain ke users agli baar sign in karte waqt SSPR methods register karein. Kaun si setting?
opts: Require users to register when signing in = Yes
Notify users on password resets = Yes
D1-090.exp: Password reset → Registration → 'Require users to register when signing in' = Yes users ko agle sign-in par apne reset methods register karne ka kehta hai. Notification settings sirf reset ke baad emails bhejti hain, aur 'number of methods required' setting khud reset ko control karti hai, registration ko nahi.

D1-091.q: Default mein kitne din baad users se apni SSPR authentication maloomat dobara confirm karwai jati hai?
D1-091.exp: Default mein users se har 180 din baad apne registered SSPR methods dobara confirm karwaye jate hain, taa ke phone numbers aur emails up to date rahein. Yeh waqfa badla ja sakta hai (0–730 din), lekin default 180 hai.

D1-092.q: Hybrid users cloud mein apne passwords reset karte hain, lekin naye passwords domain-joined PCs par kaam nahi karte. Entra Connect mein writeback enabled hai. Aur kya check karna chahiye?
opts: Password reset → On-premises integration mein Write back passwords to your on-premises directory enabled hai
Tamam users ko aisi Conditional Access policy assign ho jo domain-joined devices se password change allow kare
D1-092.exp: Password writeback do jagah on hona chahiye: Entra Connect mein, aur Entra admin center mein Password reset → On-premises integration ('Write back passwords to your on-premises directory') ke neeche. P1 kaafi hai, aur Conditional Access aur security questions writeback par asar nahi dalte.

D1-093.q: SSPR se bhoola hua password reset karne ke liye users kaun sa URL kholte hain?
D1-093.exp: Users bhoole hue passwords https://aka.ms/sspr par reset karte hain, jo passwordreset.microsoftonline.com par le jata hai, ya sign-in page par 'Forgot my password' link se. Azure portal, My Apps aur login.windows.net ke addresses reset portal nahi hain.

D1-094.q: Har SSPR statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: SSPR registration ko MFA registration ke sath combine kiya ja sakta hai
Required methods ki tadaad enabled methods se zyada ho sakti hai
Jab koi admin apna password reset kare to tamam admins ko notify kiya ja sakta hai
Cloud-only users ke liye SSPR ko Entra ID P2 chahiye
D1-094.exp: Combined registration MFA aur SSPR dono cover karti hai; required methods enabled methods se zyada nahi ho sakte; admin notifications available hain; cloud-only SSPR ke liye Entra ID P1 ya qualifying Microsoft 365 business plan chahiye, P2 nahi (Free sirf maloom password badalne deta hai).

D1-095.q: On-premises AD se joined company ke Windows laptops ko Conditional Access ke liye Entra ID mein bhi register hona hai. Kaun sa join type?
D1-095.exp: Microsoft Entra hybrid join un company devices ke liye hai jo on-premises Active Directory se joined hain aur Entra ID mein bhi registered hain. Is se Conditional Access un par bharosa kar sakta hai. Entra join cloud-only company devices ke liye hai, aur Entra registered personal (BYOD) devices ke liye.

D1-096.q: Aap har user ke join ya register kiye ja sakne wale devices ki zyada se zyada tadaad mehdood karna chahte hain. Yeh kahan set hota hai?
D1-096.exp: Entra ID → Devices → Device settings mein 'Maximum number of devices per user' hai, jo mehdood karta hai ke ek user kitne devices join ya register kar sakta hai. Conditional Access sign-in ki shartein control karta hai, Azure Policy Azure resources govern karti hai, aur is limit ke liye Intune zaroori nahi.

D1-097.q: Sirf group 'IT-Staff' ke members devices ko Microsoft Entra ID se join kar sakein. Yeh kahan configure karte hain?
opts: Device settings → Users may join devices to Microsoft Entra = Selected
Conditional Access → Device platforms → Users may join devices = Selected
D1-097.exp: Entra ID → Devices → Device settings → 'Users may join devices to Microsoft Entra' All, Selected ya None ho sakta hai. Selected chun kar IT-Staff group add karne se sirf woh users devices join kar sakte hain. App registrations, Conditional Access platforms aur Azure RBAC roles device join control nahi karte.

D1-098.q: Kaun sa device join type personal iOS aur Android phones support karta hai?
D1-098.exp: Microsoft Entra registered personal devices (BYOD) ke liye bana hai aur Windows, macOS, iOS aur Android support karta hai. Entra joined aur hybrid joined organization ki milkiyat wale Windows devices (aur kuch macOS) ke liye hain, aur domain join on-premises AD ka concept hai.

D1-099.q: Regional helpdesk staff ko sirf Lahore office ke users ke passwords reset karne hain. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Lahore users wala administrative unit, jis tak Helpdesk Administrator scoped ho
Lahore office ka resource group, jis ki IAM mein Helpdesk Administrator assigned ho
D1-099.exp: Administrative unit users ke ek hisse (yahan Lahore office) ko group karta hai. Us unit tak scoped Helpdesk Administrator assign karne se staff sirf unhi users ke passwords reset kar sakta hai. Management groups aur resource groups Azure resources organise karte hain, Entra users nahi, aur device groups admin roles mehdood nahi karte.

D1-100.q: Conditional Access policies banane ke liye kaun sa license chahiye?
D1-100.exp: Conditional Access Microsoft Entra ID P1 se shamil hai. P2 upar se risk-based conditions add karta hai (Identity Protection ke zariye), lekin basic Conditional Access ke liye P2 nahi chahiye. Free mein Conditional Access shamil nahi; is mein sirf security defaults hain.

D1-101.q: Kaun sa built-in role user ko subscription mein sab kuch dekhne deta hai lekin kuch badalne nahi deta?
D1-101.exp: Reader apne scope mein har resource aur setting dekh sakta hai lekin kuch bana, badal ya delete nahi kar sakta, aur roles assign nahi kar sakta. Contributor aur Owner resources badal sakte hain, aur User Access Administrator role assignments badal sakta hai.

D1-102.q: Kis qisam ke security principals ko Azure role assignment mil sakta hai?
opts: Users, groups, service principals aur managed identities
Users, Entra-registered devices aur resource groups
D1-102.exp: Azure role chaar qisam ke security principals ko assign ho sakta hai: users, groups, service principals (apps) aur managed identities. Devices ko roles nahi mil sakte, aur subscriptions scopes hain, principals nahi.

D1-103.q: Azure role assign karne ka sab se chhota scope kaun sa hai?
D1-103.exp: Azure roles chaar levels par assign ho sakte hain: management group, subscription, resource group, ya ek single resource. Sab se chhota individual resource hai, jaise ek storage account ya VM.

D1-104.q: Ek developer ko RG-Dev mein virtual machines manage karni hain lekin virtual network ya storage accounts manage NAHI karne. Least-privilege role kaun sa hai?
D1-104.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor VMs bana aur manage kar sakta hai lekin un se jure virtual network ya storage accounts nahi (usay sirf zaroori join permissions milti hain). RG-Dev par Contributor VNet aur storage manage karne bhi deta. Network Contributor is ka ulat hai (sirf networking), aur Owner zaroorat se kahin zyada hai.

D1-105.q: Ek engineer ko subscription mein VMs ke access ke baghair VNets, NSGs aur load balancers manage karne hain. Kaun sa role?
D1-105.exp: Network Contributor virtual networks, subnets, NSGs, load balancers aur public IPs jaise networking resources manage karne deta hai, lekin VMs ya storage nahi. Virtual Machine Contributor is ka ulat hai. Contributor mein VMs bhi aa jatin, aur Security Admin Defender for Cloud ka role hai.

D1-106.q: Ek app ko Microsoft Entra authentication se storage account mein blobs parhne hain. Kaun sa role assignment least privileged hai?
opts: Account par Storage Account Contributor, access keys ke sath
Container ya account par Storage Blob Data Reader
D1-106.exp: Entra authentication se blob contents parhne ke liye Storage Blob Data Reader jaisa data-plane role chahiye, jo container (least privilege) ya account par assign ho. Reader aur Storage Account Contributor control-plane roles hain, is liye Entra ID ke zariye data access nahi dete. Owner bohat zyada deta hai.

D1-107.q: Finance ke ek user ko invoices aur billing data dekhna hai lekin resources nahi. Kaun sa role?
D1-107.exp: Billing Reader resources ke access ke baghair invoices aur cost information jaisa billing data parh sakta hai. Reader tamam resources dikha dega. Cost Management Contributor budgets jaisi cost settings bhi badal sakta hai, jo sirf dekhne se aage hai. Owner poora control hai.

D1-108.q: Ek user ko cost data dekhna aur budgets banane hain lekin resources nahi badalne. Kaun sa role behtareen hai?
D1-108.exp: Cost Management Contributor resources badle baghair costs dekh sakta hai aur budgets aur exports jaisi cost settings manage kar sakta hai. Contributor resources badal sakta hai, Reader aur Billing Reader sirf dekh sakte hain, aur Billing Reader budgets ke bajaye billing data ke liye hai.

D1-109.q: Portal mein resource group ke liye role assignment kahan add karte hain?
opts: Resource group → Access control (IAM) → Add role assignment
Subscription → Resource providers → Register role → Add assignment
D1-109.exp: Har scope (management group, subscription, resource group aur resource) mein Access control (IAM) blade hota hai, jahan Add → Add role assignment Azure RBAC assignment banata hai. Entra ID → Roles and administrators User Administrator jaise directory roles ke liye hai, jo alag system hai.

D1-110.q: Aap maloom karna chahte hain ke ek makhsoos user ke paas resource group par kaun se roles hain, inherited samet. Portal ka sab se tez tool?
opts: Activity log → user ke naam se filter
D1-110.exp: Access control (IAM) → Check access mein aap user, group ya identity chun kar us scope par us ke tamam roles dekh sakte hain, upar ke scopes se aur group membership se inherited roles samet. Activity log pichle operations dikhata hai, mojooda access nahi, aur Advisor aur Policy RBAC report nahi karte.

D1-111.q: Kaun si CLI command user ke tamam role assignments list karti hai, upar ke scopes se inherited samet?
D1-111.exp: az role assignment list --assignee kisi principal ke role assignments list karti hai. --all subscription ke har scope ko shamil karta hai (sirf subscription ko nahi), aur --include-inherited management groups jaise upar ke scopes se inherit hue assignments bhi add karta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D1-112.q: Kaun sa PowerShell cmdlet role assign karta hai?
D1-112.exp: New-AzRoleAssignment role assignment banata hai, maslan -SignInName, -RoleDefinitionName aur -ResourceGroupName ke sath. New-AzRoleDefinition custom role banata hai (definition, assignment nahi). Add-AzRole aur Set-AzRbac mojood nahi.

D1-113.q: Ek subscription apni role assignment limit tak pohanch jati hai. Assignments kam karne ka recommended tareeqa kya hai?
opts: Individual users ke bajaye groups ko roles assign karein
Individual role assignments ki jagah deny assignments use karein
D1-113.exp: Subscription mein role assignments ki ek limit (4,000) hai. Groups ko roles assign karne se ek assignment har member ko cover kar leta hai, is liye bohat kam assignments lagte hain. Extra subscriptions, deny assignments aur Azure Policy assignments ki tadaad kam nahi karte.

D1-114.q: User1 RG1 ka Owner hai. Ek administrator RG1 par ReadOnly lock lagata hai. Kya User1 RG1 mein VM delete kar sakta hai?
opts: Haan — Owner role apne scope ke locks par haawi hota hai
Nahi — locks har user par apply hote hain chahe role kuch bhi ho
D1-114.exp: Resource locks har kisi par apply hote hain, role chahe koi bhi ho — yeh RBAC ke upar ek hifazati jaal hain. Jab tak ReadOnly lock laga hai, Owner bhi RG1 mein resources delete ya change nahi kar sakta. Owner pehle lock hata sakta hai (Owners ke paas lock permissions hain), phir delete kar sakta hai.

D1-115.q: Azure RBAC kis service par bana hai?
D1-115.exp: Azure RBAC Azure Resource Manager ka authorisation system hai: har management request ARM se guzarti hai, aur ARM chalane se pehle caller ke role assignments check karta hai. Azure Policy alag governance service hai, Entra Connect identities sync karta hai, aur Azure Monitor telemetry collect karta hai.

D1-116.q: User1 ke paas Sub1 par Contributor hai. User1 kaun se DO kaam NAHI kar sakta?
opts: Sub1 ke kisi bhi resource group mein VM banana
Sub1 par User2 ko Reader role assign karna
Sub1 mein resource group delete karna
Resource group par resource lock banana
D1-116.exp: Contributor ke Actions = * hain lekin NotActions Microsoft.Authorization/*/Write aur Delete nikal deta hai. Role assignments banana aur locks banana dono Microsoft.Authorization write operations hain, is liye Contributor yeh nahi kar sakta. Woh VMs bana aur resource groups delete kar sakta hai, kyun ke yeh aam resource operations hain.

D1-117.q: Har statement ka jawab Haan ya Nahi mein dein:
stmts: Managed identity ko role assign kiya ja sakta hai
