Group ko diye gaye role assignments us ke members par apply hote hain
Subscription scope par Reader us subscription ke har resource group ke resources parh sakta hai
Entra ID se user hatane se us ke role assignments khud delete ho jate hain
D1-117.exp: Managed identities ko roles mil sakte hain, aur group ko diya gaya role us ke tamam members par apply hota hai. Subscription scope par Reader har resource group aur resource mein inherit hota hai. Lekin Entra ID mein user delete karne se us ke role assignments nahi hatte — woh 'Identity not found' ki surat mein rehte hain jab tak aap unhein saaf na karein.

D1-118.q: Subscription ko doosre Entra tenant mein move karne ke baad purane tenant ke users resources manage nahi kar sakte. Kyun?
opts: Transfer par resources delete ho jate hain
Subscription ka tenant badalne par tamam role assignments permanently hat jate hain
Subscription 30 din ke liye disable rehti hai jab tak naya tenant transfer confirm na kare
D1-118.exp: Subscription ko doosre Microsoft Entra tenant mein move karne se us ke tamam Azure RBAC role assignments permanently delete ho jate hain, kyun ke purane tenant ke users aur groups naye tenant mein mojood nahi. Resources chalte rehte hain, lekin aap ko naye tenant mein role assignments dobara banane honge.

D1-119.q: Azure RBAC 'conditions' (ABAC) role assignments ke upar aap ko kya karne deti hain?
opts: Attribute-based checks add karna, maslan blob index tags se blob access mehdood karna
Tenant ka tamam access deny karna
Schedule lagana, maslan blob access sirf kaam ke auqat aur hafte ke dinon mein activate karna
D1-119.exp: Role assignment conditions (attribute-based access control) role assignment par ek extra check lagati hain, jaise 'sirf woh blobs jin ka index tag Project=Alpha ho' ya 'sirf logs naam ke containers'. Yeh role ko aur tang karti hain. Yeh poora tenant deny nahi karti, assignments schedule nahi karti (woh PIM hai), aur MFA enforce nahi karti (woh Conditional Access hai).

D1-120.q: Admins ko Owner role sirf zaroorat par, mehdood waqt ke liye, approval ke sath activate karna hai. Kaun sa feature?
opts: Owner role ke liye Microsoft Entra access reviews
D1-120.exp: Privileged Identity Management users ko role ka permanent assignment dene ke bajaye eligible banata hai. Woh usay sirf zaroorat par, mehdood waqt ke liye activate karte hain, chahein to approval, MFA aur justification ke sath. Is ke liye Entra ID P2 ya ID Governance chahiye. Locks, policies aur access reviews just-in-time access nahi dete.

D1-121.q: Kaun sa built-in role resource locks aur role assignments manage karne deta hai lekin doosre resources nahi?
D1-121.exp: User Access Administrator ke paas Microsoft.Authorization par poore rights hain, jis mein role assignments aur management locks aa jate hain, aur doosre resources par koi right nahi. Contributor resources manage karta hai lekin Microsoft.Authorization writes se jaan boojh kar roka gaya hai, is liye locks ya access manage nahi kar sakta.

D1-122.q: Tenant Root Group management group par role assign kiya gaya hai. Yeh kya cover karta hai?
opts: Tenant ke tamam management groups, subscriptions aur resources
Sirf Entra ID objects, jaise users, groups aur app registrations
Kuch nahi; root par assignments allowed nahi
D1-122.exp: Tenant root group management group hierarchy ki choti hai. Wahan assign kiya gaya role tenant ke har management group, subscription, resource group aur resource mein inherit hota hai. Yeh Entra ID objects cover nahi karta, kyun ke un ke liye alag Entra roles hain.

D1-123.q: Owner role ko kaun si baat behtareen tarah bayan karti hai?
opts: Tamam resources manage karne ka poora access, Azure RBAC mein roles assign karna samet
Tamam resources manage karne ka poora access, lekin Azure RBAC mein roles assign karne ka haq nahi
D1-123.exp: Owner ke paas apne scope par resources ki har permission hai aur woh doosron ko roles bhi assign kar sakta hai. Yeh asal mein Contributor plus User Access Administrator hai. Yeh resources delete kar sakta hai aur billing tak mehdood nahi.

D1-124.q: Ek user Group A (RG1 par Reader) aur Group B (RG1 par Contributor) mein hai. Koi deny assignment nahi. RG1 par asal permission kya hai?
D1-124.exp: Azure RBAC additive hai: user ki asal permissions us ke tamam role assignments ka majmua (union) hain, direct hon ya groups ke zariye. RG1 par Reader plus Contributor wo sab deta hai jo Contributor allow karta hai. Roles kabhi ek doosre ko khatam nahi karte; sirf deny assignment permissions cheen sakti hai.

D1-125.q: Jab deny assignment kisi aise role assignment se takrata hai jo wahi action allow karta hai to kya hota hai?
D1-125.exp: Deny assignments role assignments se pehle evaluate hote hain. Agar deny assignment kisi action ko rokta hai to user woh nahi kar sakta, chahe us ka koi role usay allow kare. Inhein Azure khud banata hai, maslan deny settings wale deployment stacks, administrators seedhe add nahi karte.

D1-126.q: Custom role ka kaun sa hissa blob contents parhne jaise data-plane operations control karta hai?
D1-126.exp: Role definitions control plane ko data plane se alag rakhti hain. Actions aur NotActions management operations cover karte hain, jaise storage account banana. DataActions aur NotDataActions andar ke data par operations cover karte hain, jaise blob contents parhna ya likhna. AssignableScopes batata hai ke role kahan assign ho sakta hai.

D1-127.q: Portal mein mojooda built-in role jaisa custom role banane ka sab se tez tareeqa kya hai?
opts: IAM → Roles → built-in role select karein → Clone
D1-127.exp: Kisi bhi scope ke Access control (IAM) → Roles mein aap built-in role chun kar Clone kar sakte hain, jis se us ki permissions pehle se bhari hui custom role shuru hoti hai, phir actions add ya remove karein. Entra ID → Roles directory roles ke liye hai, aur policy definitions alag feature hai.

D1-128.q: Kaun si CLI command JSON file se custom role banati hai?
D1-128.exp: az role definition create --role-definition role.json ek JSON file se custom role banati hai jis mein Name, Actions, NotActions, DataActions aur AssignableScopes hote hain. az role assignment create sirf mojooda role assign karti hai, aur policy definitions alag feature hai.

D1-129.q: Kya custom role AssignableScopes mein root scope "/" use kar sakta hai?
opts: Haan — koi bhi Global Administrator custom role ki definition mein root scope add kar sakta hai
Nahi — custom roles root scope use nahi kar sakte; wahan sirf built-in roles available hain
D1-129.exp: Custom role ke AssignableScopes mein management groups, subscriptions ya resource groups ho sakte hain, lekin root scope "/" nahi. Root par sirf built-in roles assign ho sakte hain. Licences aur data actions is ko nahi badalte.

D1-130.q: Custom role AssignableScopes mein kitne management groups list kar sakta hai?
D1-130.exp: Custom role ke AssignableScopes mein kai subscriptions aur resource groups ho sakte hain, lekin zyada se zyada ek management group. Yeh platform ki limit hai, is liye 'unlimited' aur '5 tak' ghalat hain; management groups allowed hain, bas sirf ek.

D1-131.q: Ek custom role ke Actions ["Microsoft.Compute/*"] aur NotActions ["Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/delete"] hain. User ke paas usi scope par Contributor bhi hai. Kya woh VM delete kar sakta hai?
opts: Nahi — NotActions us scope par user ke har role ke liye deny ka kaam karta hai
Haan — NotActions doosre role ki di hui permissions block nahi karta
Nahi — custom roles built-in roles ko override karte hain
D1-131.exp: NotActions deny nahi hai. Yeh sirf usi ek custom role se actions nikalta hai. Kyun ke RBAC additive hai, user ke Contributor role mein ab bhi Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/delete shamil hai, is liye user VM delete kar sakta hai. Sirf deny assignment isay rok sakti hai.

opts: Storage accounts aur un ke child control-plane resources par tamam operations
Har storage account ke tamam blobs, files, queues aur tables ka data access
D1-132.exp: * wildcard Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts ke neeche har control-plane operation deta hai — create, read, update, delete, list keys aur child resources. Yeh blobs ka data access nahi deta; us ke liye DataActions chahiye. Yeh sirf storage accounts cover karta hai, har resource provider nahi.

D1-133.q: Kaun si operation string user ko virtual machines start karne deti hai?
D1-133.exp: VM start karna ek action hai, is liye us ki operation string Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action hai. /write operation VM definition banata ya update karta hai, jo alag permission hai. Microsoft.Compute/start ya Microsoft.VM/start jaisi strings mojood nahi.

D1-134.q: CLI se custom role banane aur use karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: az role assignment create se role assign karein
Role definition JSON likhein (Actions, AssignableScopes)
az role definition create chalayen
az role definition list --custom-role-only se verify karein
D1-134.exp: Pehle Name, Actions aur AssignableScopes ke sath JSON likhein. Phir az role definition create se role banayen. az role definition list --custom-role-only true se check karein ke woh mojood hai. Sirf tab az role assignment create se assign kar sakte hain, kyun ke role assign hone se pehle mojood hona chahiye.

D1-135.q: Custom roles ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Custom roles usi tenant par bharosa karne wali subscriptions mein share ho sakte hain
Custom role apne AssignableScopes se bahar assign ho sakta hai
Custom roles ke liye Entra ID P1 ya P2 chahiye
Custom roles mein DataActions ho sakte hain
D1-135.exp: Custom roles usi tenant mein listed scopes ke andar use ho sakte hain; AssignableScopes se bahar assign nahi ho sakte; koi Entra premium license nahi chahiye; DataActions supported hain.

D1-136.q: Monitoring team ko resources badle baghair metrics aur logs dekhne aur alert rules banane ke liye kaun sa role milna chahiye?
D1-136.exp: Monitoring Contributor tamam monitoring data parh sakta hai aur alert rules aur diagnostic settings jaisi monitoring settings badal sakta hai, khud resources badle baghair. Contributor aur Owner kahin zyada access dete hain, aur Log Analytics Reader sirf data parh sakta hai.

D1-137.q: Ek user ko sirf metrics aur logs jaisa monitoring data parhna hai. Kaun sa role?
D1-137.exp: Monitoring Reader tamam monitoring data — metrics, logs aur alert settings — parh sakta hai lekin kuch badal nahi sakta. Monitoring Contributor alerts bana aur diagnostic settings bhi badal sakta hai. Log Analytics Contributor workspaces manage kar sakta hai, jo read-only se zyada hai.

D1-138.q: Ek backup operator ko backups manage karne hain (backup start, restore) lekin backup data ya vaults delete nahi karne. Kaun sa role?
D1-138.exp: Backup Operator backups aur restores chala sakta hai lekin backup data hata, vaults bana ya access de nahi sakta. Backup Contributor backup policies manage aur backup data hata bhi sakta hai.

D1-139.q: Kaun sa role user ko Microsoft Entra login se VM mein OS ke andar administrator privileges ke sath connect karne deta hai?
D1-139.exp: Entra-based VM login Virtual Machine Administrator Login (OS mein admin rights) ya Virtual Machine User Login (aam user) use karta hai. VM Contributor OS login nahi deta.

D1-140.q: Aap ek guest user ko RG1 par Reader role assign karte hain. Guest Azure portal mein kya dekhta hai?
opts: Kuch nahi — guests Azure use nahi kar sakte
Aap ki directory par switch karne ke baad RG1 ke resources
Aap ki directory par switch karne ke baad tenant ka har resource
D1-140.exp: RG1 par Reader paane wala guest apne account se sign in karta hai, portal mein aap ki directory par switch karta hai, aur sirf RG1 ke resources dekhta hai. Woh doosre resource groups ya baqi tenant nahi dekhta, kyun ke us ke paas kahin aur koi role nahi.

D1-141.ctx: Assignments: User1 — RG-A par Owner. User2 — Sub1 par User Access Administrator (Sub1 mein RG-A hai). User3 — Sub1 par Contributor.
D1-141.q: Kaun se users User4 ko RG-A par Reader role de sakte hain?
D1-141.exp: User1 RG-A par Owner hai, jis mein access dena shamil hai. User2 Sub1 par User Access Administrator hai, aur yeh role RG-A mein inherit hota hai. User3 Contributor hai, jo role assignments nahi bana sakta. Is liye User1 aur User2 Reader de sakte hain.

D1-142.ctx: User1 ke paas management group MG1 (jis mein Sub1 hai) par Reader aur Sub1 mein RG-VMs par Virtual Machine Contributor hai.
D1-142.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: User1 RG-VMs mein VM restart kar sakta hai
User1 RG-VMs mein virtual network bana sakta hai
User1 Sub1 ke doosre resource groups mein storage accounts dekh sakta hai
User1 RG-VMs par kisi aur user ko Reader assign kar sakta hai
D1-142.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor restart jaise VM actions cover karta hai, lekin virtual networks banana nahi. MG1 par Reader Sub1 mein inherit hota hai, is liye User1 har resource group mein storage accounts dekh sakta hai. Kisi role mein roleAssignments/write nahi, is liye User1 roles assign nahi kar sakta.

D1-143.q: Microsoft Entra directory roles (jaise User Administrator) kahan assign hote hain?
D1-143.exp: User Administrator ya Global Administrator jaise directory roles khud Entra ID ko control karte hain aur Entra ID → Roles and administrators mein assign hote hain. Subscription par Access control (IAM) resources ke liye Azure RBAC roles assign karta hai. Yeh do role systems alag hain.

D1-144.q: Kaun sa Entra role sab se zyada privileged hai aur jitne kam logon ko mumkin ho assign karna chahiye?
D1-144.exp: Global Administrator ke paas Microsoft Entra ID aur us ko use karne wali services ke har hisse ka poora access hai. Microsoft paanch se kam Global Administrators rakhne aur rozmarra kaam ke liye User Administrator jaise kam privilege wale roles use karne ki salah deta hai.

D1-145.q: Kya kisi group ko Microsoft Entra directory role assign ho sakta hai?
opts: Haan, agar group role-assignable (isAssignableToRole = true) bana ho
Haan, koi bhi security group, bas us ki membership type Dynamic user ho
D1-145.exp: Groups ko Entra directory roles sirf tab mil sakte hain jab woh role-assignable (isAssignableToRole = true) bane hon. Yeh setting banate waqt chuni jati hai aur baad mein badli nahi ja sakti, aur role-assignable groups dynamic membership use nahi kar sakte. Aam groups ko Entra roles nahi diye ja sakte.

D1-146.q: Ek user ko sirf app registrations aur enterprise applications manage karni hain. Least-privilege Entra role?
D1-146.exp: Application Administrator app registrations aur enterprise applications bana aur manage kar sakta hai, un ki single sign-on aur proxy settings samet, baghair wide directory rights ke. Global Administrator bohat zyada hoga, User Administrator users aur groups manage karta hai, aur Cloud Device Administrator devices manage karta hai.

D1-147.q: VM par chalne wali app ko code mein credentials rakhe baghair Key Vault access karna hai. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: VM ki managed identity, jise Key Vault ka access diya gaya ho
Storage account key, jo VM ke environment variable mein rakhi ho
App settings mein kisi user ka password
D1-147.exp: Managed identity VM ko Entra ID mein aisi identity deti hai jo Azure manage karta hai, code mein koi secret nahi. Us identity ko Key Vault ka access dein (RBAC role ya access policy), aur app VM ke local endpoint se tokens le leti hai. Keys, passwords aur SAS tokens sab ko kahin na kahin store karna parta.

D1-148.q: Paanch VMs ko WAHI identity same permissions ke sath chahiye, aur agar koi VM delete ho to identity baqi rehni chahiye. Kaun si qisam?
D1-148.exp: User-assigned identities alag resources hain, kai resources mein share ho sakti hain, aur un ki zindagi alag hoti hai. System-assigned identities apne resource ke sath delete ho jati hain.

D1-149.q: Jab VM delete hoti hai to us ki system-assigned managed identity ka kya hota hai?
opts: Khud ba khud delete ho jati hai
D1-149.exp: System-assigned managed identity apne resource ke sath banti hai aur usi ke sath zindagi guzarti hai, is liye VM delete karne se identity bhi delete ho jati hai aur us ke role assignments kaam karna band kar dete hain. Agar aap ko aisi identity chahiye jo resource ke baad bhi rahe ya kai resources share karein, to user-assigned identity use karein.

D1-150.q: Web app ko credentials ke baghair Key Vault (RBAC permission model) se secrets parhne dene ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Vault par identity ko 'Key Vault Secrets User' assign karein
Web app par system-assigned managed identity enable karein
App se us ki identity use kar ke secret reference karein
Confirm karein ke vault Azure RBAC permission model use karta hai
D1-150.exp: Pehle web app ki managed identity enable karein, taa ke access dene ke liye identity mojood ho. Confirm karein ke vault Azure RBAC permission model use karta hai, phir identity ko Key Vault Secrets User assign karein. Aakhir mein app se secret reference karein, jo usay identity se parhti hai — koi credentials nahi chahiye.

D1-151.q: Kaun sa Azure Policy effect non-compliant resource ko banne se rokta hai?
D1-151.exp: Deny resource banne ya update hone se pehle request evaluate karta hai, aur agar woh rule torti ho to reject kar deta hai, is liye non-compliant resource kabhi banta hi nahi. Audit aur AuditIfNotExists sirf report karte hain, aur Append rokne ke bajaye request mein fields add karta hai.

D1-152.q: Har naye resource group par 'costcenter' tag hona zaroori hai, aur missing ho to banana fail hona chahiye. Kaun si built-in policy aur effect?
opts: Require a tag on resource groups — Deny
Subscription se tag inherit karna — Modify
D1-152.exp: Built-in 'Require a tag on resource groups' policy Deny effect use karti hai, is liye costcenter tag ke baghair resource group banana fail ho jata hai. 'Inherit a tag' (Modify) pehle se mojood tag copy karti hai, enforce nahi karti, Append fail karne ke bajaye value add karta hai, aur 'Allowed locations' regions ke bare mein hai.

D1-153.q: Kaun sa effect resources banne ya update hone ke dauran tags add ya replace karta hai, aur mojooda resources ki remediation support karta hai?
D1-153.exp: Modify resource banne ya update hone ke dauran tags (aur kuch doosri properties) add, replace ya remove kar sakta hai. Pehle se mojood resources ke liye remediation task assignment ki managed identity ke zariye change apply karta hai. Audit sirf report karta hai, Deny rokta hai, aur Disabled policy band kar deta hai.

D1-154.q: Aap ko VM sizes sirf D-series tak mehdood karne hain. Kaun si built-in policy?
D1-154.exp: Built-in 'Allowed virtual machine size SKUs' policy allowed sizes ki list leti hai, jaise D-series, aur kisi bhi aur size ka deployment deny karti hai. 'Allowed locations' regions mehdood karti hai, aur resource-type policies sizes ke bajaye poore resource types allow ya block karti hain.

D1-155.q: Aap ko subscription mein kisi ko bhi public IP addresses banane se rokna hai. Sab se aasan built-in policy?
D1-155.exp: Built-in 'Not allowed resource types' policy aap ke list kiye gaye resource types ka har deployment deny karti hai. Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses list karne se us scope mein koi public IP nahi bana sakta. 'Allowed locations' aur 'Require a tag' koi resource type block nahi karti.

D1-156.q: Ek assignment DeployIfNotExists use karta hai. Remediation task authorization error ke sath fail hota hai. Sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?
opts: Policy ki managed identity ke paas target scope par zaroori role assignment nahi
Resource locks maujood nahi, is liye remediation task target scope ko protect nahi kar sakta
D1-156.exp: DeployIfNotExists aur Modify remediations policy assignment ki managed identity ke taur par chalti hain. Agar us identity ke paas target scope par zaroori role (maslan Contributor) nahi to remediation authorization error ke sath fail hoti hai. Audit mode, locks aur budgets ka is se taluq nahi.

D1-157.q: Azure Policy pehle se assign ki gayi policies ka standard compliance evaluation kitni baar chalati hai?
D1-157.exp: Azure Policy resources ko tab evaluate karti hai jab woh bante ya update hote hain, jab assignment banta ya badalta hai, aur har 24 ghante ke standard compliance scan mein. Aap on-demand scan bhi chala sakte hain, maslan az policy state trigger-scan se.

D1-158.q: Kaun si command resource group ke liye on-demand policy compliance scan trigger karti hai?
D1-158.exp: az policy state trigger-scan subscription ya, --resource-group ke sath, ek resource group ke liye on-demand compliance evaluation shuru karti hai (PowerShell mein: Start-AzPolicyComplianceScan). Is ke baghair aap 24 ghante ke cycle ka intezar karte hain. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D1-159.q: Policy kin scopes par assign ho sakti hai?
opts: Management group, subscription ya resource group
Entra ID tenant, administrative unit ya security group
D1-159.exp: Policy assignments management groups, subscriptions ya resource groups ko target karte hain aur neeche ki har cheez par apply hote hain. Child resource groups ya individual resources ko assignment se exclude kiya ja sakta hai.

D1-160.q: Policy exclusion aur policy exemption mein kya farq hai?
opts: Exclusion scope ko evaluation se bilkul nikal deta hai; exemption usay evaluate karti hai lekin Exempt mark karti hai
Exemption scope ko evaluation se bilkul nikal deti hai; exclusion usay evaluate karti hai lekin reports se chhupa deti hai
D1-160.exp: Exclusion scope ko assignment se poori tarah nikal deta hai, is liye woh bilkul evaluate nahi hota. Exemption scope ko evaluate karti rehti hai lekin usay Exempt mark karti hai, category (Waiver ya Mitigated) aur optional expiry date ke sath, is liye woh compliance reports mein nazar aata rehta hai.

D1-161.q: Deny policy ke pilot ke dauran aap ko kuch block kiye baghair compliance results chahiye. Sab se tez option kya hai?
opts: Assignment ka enforcement mode DoNotEnforce par set karein
Assignment ka scope tenant root management group par set karein
D1-161.exp: Assignment ka enforcementMode DoNotEnforce karne se Azure Policy resources evaluate karti hai aur compliance report karti hai, lekin kuch block nahi karti. Is se enforce karne se pehle aap dekh sakte hain ke Deny policy kis par asar dalegi. Policy delete karne se koi result hi nahi milega, aur locks ka is se taluq nahi.

D1-162.q: Kaun sa effect check karta hai ke koi related resource mojood hai (maslan VM par antimalware extension) aur sirf report karta hai?
D1-162.exp: AuditIfNotExists check karta hai ke koi related resource mojood hai — jaise VM par extension ya kisi resource par diagnostic setting — aur agar nahi to resource ko non-compliant mark karta hai. Yeh sirf report karta hai. DeployIfNotExists missing resource deploy bhi kar deta, aur Deny requests rokta hai.

D1-163.q: Kaun se DO effects remediation task se remediate ho sakte hain?
D1-163.exp: Sirf DeployIfNotExists aur Modify baad mein resources badal sakte hain, is liye sirf yahi mojooda non-compliant resources ke liye remediation tasks support karte hain. Audit sirf report karta hai, aur Deny sirf naye requests rokta hai; dono ke paas remediate karne ko kuch nahi.

D1-164.q: Aap ko darjanon policies ke zariye ISO 27001 jaise controls enforce karne hain. Sab se efficient tareeqa kya hai?
opts: Ek built-in initiative (policy set) ek baar assign karein
Har policy ko har subscription par alag alag assign karein
D1-164.exp: Initiative bohat si policy definitions ko group karta hai, is liye ek built-in initiative (maslan koi regulatory compliance standard) assign karne se ek hi step mein darjanon controls apply ho jate hain aur ek compliance score milta hai. Har policy alag assign karna kahin zyada mehnat hai, aur locks aur Advisor compliance controls enforce nahi karte.

D1-165.q: Policy A (subscription par assigned) East US deny karti hai. Policy B (RG1 par assigned) sirf East US allow karti hai. Kya koi RG1 mein resource bana sakta hai?
opts: Haan, East US mein — RG-level policy jeetti hai, kyunke woh resource ke zyada qareeb hai
Nahi — dono policies evaluate hoti hain; RG1 mein har location in mein se kisi ek se deny hoti hai
D1-165.exp: Policies jur jati hain — neeche ke scope ki policy upar wali ko override nahi kar sakti. RG1 mein East US Policy A se deny hota hai, aur baqi har region Policy B se. Is liye RG1 mein kuch nahi ban sakta, user ka role chahe kuch bhi ho.

D1-166.q: Policy definition ki kaun si technique ek definition ko har assignment mein mukhtalif allowed values ke sath dobara use karne deti hai?
D1-166.exp: Policy parameters ek definition ko har assignment ke liye mukhtalif values lene dete hain — maslan allowed locations ki list jo har subscription ke liye alag ho. Aliases resource properties se map hote hain, aur tags aur locks policy features nahi hain.

D1-167.q: Azure Policy ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Deny policy Owner role wale users par bhi apply hoti hai
Policy SKU ya location jaisi resource properties evaluate kar sakti hai
Management group par policy assignments child subscriptions mein inherit hote hain
Policy control karti hai ke kaun Azure mein sign in kar sakta hai
D1-167.exp: Deny policy har kisi par apply hoti hai, Owners samet, kyun ke Policy request check karti hai, user nahi. Yeh SKU ya location jaisi properties evaluate kar sakti hai, aur management group par assignments us ki subscriptions mein inherit hote hain. Policy yeh control nahi karti ke kaun sign in kar sakta hai — woh Conditional Access hai.

D1-168.q: Subscription par allowed locations enforce karne aur Modify policy se mojooda resources ke tags theek karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Modify assignment ke liye remediation task banayen
Subscription par Deny ke sath 'Allowed locations' assign karein
Managed identity ke sath Modify tag policy assign karein
Compliance dashboard review karein
D1-168.exp: Pehle Deny policy assign karein taa ke allowed locations se bahar naye resources block hon. Phir managed identity ke sath Modify tag policy assign karein, kyun ke remediation usi identity ke taur par chalti hai. Uske baad mojooda resources theek karne ke liye remediation task chalayen. Aakhir mein nateeja confirm karne ke liye compliance dashboard check karein.

D1-169.q: Aap production SQL server ko ghalti se delete hone se bachana chahte hain, lekin admins ko phir bhi usay scale karna hai. Kaun sa lock?
opts: Koi lock nahi; RBAC Reader use karein
D1-169.exp: CanNotDelete lock kisi ko server delete karne se rokta hai lekin scaling jaise changes allow karta hai. ReadOnly lock scaling bhi block kar deta. Admins ko sirf Reader dene se woh bhi scale nahi kar payenge, aur Deny policy control karti hai ke resources kaise configure hon, yeh nahi ke woh delete ho sakte hain ya nahi.

D1-170.q: App Service plan par ReadOnly lock laga hai. Jab aap plan scale out karne ki koshish karte hain to kya hota hai?
opts: Fail hota hai — scaling write operation hai
D1-170.exp: ReadOnly lock sirf read (GET) operations allow karta hai. App Service plan scale out karna us ki configuration badalta hai, jo write hai, is liye lock hatne tak fail hota hai. Yeh manual scaling aur autoscale dono par apply hota hai.

D1-171.q: Resource group par CanNotDelete lock hai. Kya aap Owner role se resource group delete kar sakte hain?
D1-171.exp: Resource group par CanNotDelete lock har user ke liye, Owners samet, usay (aur us ke resources ko) delete karna block karta hai. Pehle lock hatayen — Owners ke paas iski permission hai — phir delete karein. Koi --force flag nahi jo locks ko bypass kare.

D1-172.q: Kaun si CLI command resource group RG1 par delete lock banati hai?
opts: az lock create --name NoDelete --lock-type CanNotDelete --resource-group RG1
az policy lock create --name NoDelete --effect Deny --resource-group RG1 --force
D1-172.exp: az lock create --lock-type CanNotDelete --resource-group RG1 resource group par delete lock banati hai (read-only lock ke liye ReadOnly use karein). Baqi commands asal nahi; az policy policies banati hai, locks nahi.

D1-173.q: VM ke resource group par ReadOnly lock hai. Users batate hain ke woh VM start nahi kar pa rahe. Kyun?
opts: Start POST action hai, aur ReadOnly sirf reads allow karta hai
ReadOnly lock VM ko deallocate kar ke us ka compute chhor deta hai
D1-173.exp: VM start karna POST action (Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action) hai. ReadOnly locks sirf GET requests allow karte hain, is liye start fail hota hai, restart aur deallocate bhi. Lock hatayen ya agar VMs ko aam tarah chalna hai to CanNotDelete use karein.

D1-174.q: Locks ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Locks blobs likhne jaise data-plane operations par apply hote hain
Subscription par lock tamam resource groups mein inherit hota hai
CanNotDelete resource configuration changes ki ijazat deta hai
Contributor lock hata sakta hai
D1-174.exp: Locks sirf control-plane operations par apply hote hain, is liye blobs likhne jaise data operations chalte rehte hain. Subscription par lock har resource group mein inherit hota hai. CanNotDelete configuration changes ki ijazat deta hai. Contributor locks nahi hata sakta, kyun ke us ke paas Microsoft.Authorization/locks permissions nahi.

D1-175.q: Har resource par zyada se zyada kitne tag name/value pairs ho sakte hain?
D1-175.exp: Har resource, resource group aur subscription par 50 tag name/value pairs tak ho sakte hain. Yeh platform ki limit hai, is liye 15, 100 aur unlimited ghalat hain. Agar zyada data chahiye to usay ek tag value mein JSON ki surat mein rakhein.

D1-176.q: Finance department ke hisaab se grouped monthly cost reports chahta hai. Sab se aasan setup kya hai?
opts: Resources par department tag lagayen aur Cost analysis mein us tag se group karein
Har resource ke liye ek subscription banayen
Har department ka budget banayen aur Azure Advisor mein us budget se group karein
D1-176.exp: Resources par department jaisa key wala tag lagayen, phir Cost Management → Cost analysis mein us tag se group ya filter kar ke har department ka kharcha dekhein. Har resource ki alag subscription amli nahi, locks costs par asar nahi dalte, aur budgets kharche par alert karte hain, department ke hisaab se report nahi karte.

D1-177.q: Kaun sa role user ko resources tak access ke BAGHAIR un par tags manage karne deta hai?
D1-177.exp: Tag Contributor resources par tags add, change aur remove kar sakta hai, baghair un tak kisi aur access ke. Contributor resources ka poora control de deta, Reader tags nahi badal sakta, aur User Access Administrator role assignments manage karta hai.

D1-178.q: Kaun si CLI command mojooda resource group par doosre tags hataye baghair tag env=prod add karti hai?
D1-178.exp: az tag update --operation Merge ke sath env=prod add karta hai aur mojooda tags rakhta hai. --operation Replace list mein na hone wala har tag hata deta. az group update --tags poori tag list set karta hai, is liye merge ke bajaye tags hata sakta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D1-179.q: Cost Management mein kaun sa feature reporting ke liye subscription aur resource group tags ko child resources ke usage records par apply karta hai?
D1-179.exp: Cost Management ki tag inheritance setting subscription aur resource group tags ko child resources ke usage records par apply karti hai, taa ke cost reports un se group kar sakein. Yeh resources nahi badalti. Policy Deny deployments block karti hai, aur locks aur budgets tags handle nahi karte.

D1-180.q: Resource group delete karne par us ke resources ka kya hota hai?
opts: Default RG mein move ho jate hain
D1-180.exp: Resource group ek lifecycle container hai: usay delete karne se us ke andar ka har resource delete ho jata hai — VMs, disks, networks aur sab kuch. Kuch bhi kahin move ya peeche nahi rehta, isi liye ahem resource groups par delete locks lagana acha hai.

D1-181.q: Kya West Europe ke resource group mein East US mein deploy ki gayi VM ho sakti hai?
opts: Nahi — VM ka region us ke resource group se match hona chahiye
Haan — RG ki location sirf metadata store karti hai
D1-181.exp: Resource group ki location sirf yeh batati hai ke us ka metadata kahan store hota hai. Andar ke resources kisi bhi region mein ho sakte hain, is liye West Europe ke resource group mein East US ki VM ho sakti hai. Regions ka match hona zaroori nahi, aur peering ka is se koi taluq nahi.

D1-182.q: Kya ek resource ek hi waqt mein do resource groups ka hissa ho sakta hai?
opts: Nahi — resource bilkul ek resource group ka hissa hota hai
Haan — agar dono resource groups ek hi region mein hon
D1-182.exp: Har resource ek waqt mein bilkul ek resource group ka hissa hota hai. Aap usay doosre resource group mein move kar sakte hain, lekin woh ek sath do mein nahi ho sakta. Tags reporting ke liye resource groups ke aar paar resources group karne dete hain, baghair yeh badle ke woh kahan rehte hain.

D1-183.q: Resources doosri subscription mein move karne se pehle, move kiye baghair kaise check karein ke woh kamyab hoga?
D1-183.exp: Azure move kiye baghair usay validate kar sakta hai: jab aap move shuru karte hain to portal validation chalata hai, aur validateMoveResources API (az resource invoke-action --action validateMoveResources) check karti hai ke tamam resources aur dependencies move ho sakti hain. What-if template deployments ka preview deta hai, moves ka nahi.

D1-184.q: Resources doosri subscription mein move karne ke liye kya zaroori hai?
opts: Source aur destination subscriptions ek hi Entra tenant mein hon aur destination mein resource provider registered ho
Destination subscription khaali ho aur source wale region mein ho, aur move se pehle tamam resources band hon
D1-184.exp: Resources doosri subscription mein move karne ke liye dono subscriptions ek hi Microsoft Entra tenant mein honi chahiye, aur destination mein resource provider registered hona chahiye (maslan Microsoft.Compute). Destination ka khali hona zaroori nahi, aur koi Entra licence nahi chahiye.

D1-185.q: Kaun si CLI command resource ko doosre resource group mein move karti hai?
D1-185.exp: az resource move --destination-group RG2 --ids <resource IDs> ek ya zyada resources ko doosre resource group mein move karti hai (subscription badalne ke liye --destination-subscription-id add karein). Baqi commands mojood nahi. Move ke dauran dono resource groups lock rehte hain.

D1-186.q: Aap ka deployment kisi region mein vCPUs ke liye 'QuotaExceeded' error ke sath fail hota hai. Aap kya karenge?
opts: Usage + quotas mein quota increase ki request karein
Subscription ko doosre Entra tenant mein move karein
D1-186.exp: vCPU quotas har region aur har subscription ke liye set hote hain. Jab deployment limit se takraye to Subscription → Usage + quotas (ya Help + support) mein increase ki request karein. Locks, tenant badalna aur budgets quotas nahi badalte.

D1-187.q: Deployment 'The subscription is not registered to use namespace Microsoft.ContainerInstance' error ke sath fail hota hai. Hal kya hai?
D1-187.exp: Kisi resource type ko use karne se pehle us ka resource provider subscription mein registered hona chahiye. az provider register --namespace Microsoft.ContainerInstance (ya portal mein Resource providers → Register) chalane se error theek ho jata hai. Is ka licences, management groups ya policies se taluq nahi.

D1-188.q: Koi organization kai subscriptions kyun use karegi?
opts: Billing alag karne, quotas aur access ki hudood lagane, aur environments (prod/dev) alag rakhne ke liye
Subscriptions billing ke baghair muft banti hain
Azure ki is shart ke liye ke production VMs, storage accounts aur VNets alag subscriptions mein hon
Zyada Entra tenants lene ke liye
D1-188.exp: Subscriptions billing (har ek ki ek invoice), scale (quotas har subscription par lagte hain) aur management (RBAC aur policies har subscription par assign ho sakti hain) ki hudood hain. Is liye production ko development se alag rakhne ke liye achi hain. Subscriptions muft nahi, aur VMs ko apni subscription nahi chahiye.

D1-189.q: Management groups ka asal maqsad kya hai?
opts: Kai subscriptions par access, policy aur compliance manage karna
Kai tenants mein licensing ke liye users aur devices ko group karna
D1-189.exp: Management groups subscriptions se upar hote hain. Kisi ek par jo bhi assign karein — RBAC roles ya Azure Policy — woh us ke neeche har subscription mein inherit hota hai, is liye aap ek assignment se bohat si subscriptions govern kar sakte hain. In mein VMs, DNS zones ya users nahi hote.

D1-190.q: Ek subscription ke kitne parent management groups ho sakte hain?
D1-190.exp: Management group hierarchy ek tree hai, is liye har subscription aur management group ka bilkul ek parent hota hai. Subscription ek waqt mein do management groups mein nahi ho sakti; aap usay ek se doosre mein move karte hain.

D1-191.q: Default mein nayi subscriptions management group hierarchy mein kahan rakhi jati hain?
opts: Sab se naye management group ke neeche
D1-191.exp: Nayi subscriptions default mein tenant root group ke neeche jati hain. Hierarchy settings mein aap doosra default management group chun sakte hain, taa ke nayi subscriptions sahi policies wali jagah pohanchein. 'Default' naam ka koi group khud nahi banta.

D1-192.q: Ek directory taqreeban kitne management groups support kar sakti hai?
D1-192.exp: Ek Microsoft Entra directory mein 10,000 tak management groups ho sakte hain, chhe levels gehri hierarchy mein (root aur subscriptions ko gine baghair). Yeh zyada tar organizations ki zaroorat se kahin zyada hai.

D1-193.q: Sab se kam mehnat se ek 'Allowed locations' policy 12 subscriptions par apply karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Management group par 'Allowed locations' policy assign karein
'Corp' naam ka management group banayen
12 subscriptions ko 'Corp' ke neeche move karein
Har subscription ki compliance verify karein
D1-193.exp: Management group banayen, 12 subscriptions us ke neeche move karein, aur phir management group par policy ek baar assign karein. Inheritance usay tamam 12 subscriptions par apply kar deta hai. Aakhir mein compliance check karein. Pehle assign karna bhi chal jata, lekin assign karne se pehle subscriptions move karne se tarteeb mantiqi rehti hai aur kuch nahi chhootta.

D1-194.q: Jab asal kharcha monthly budget ke 90% tak pohanche to aap ko email aur webhook call chahiye. Aap kya configure karenge?
opts: 90% par alert condition wala budget jo action group use kare
Azure Policy, mahana kharche ke 90% par Audit effect ke sath
D1-194.exp: Cost Management mein budget ki alert conditions ho sakti hain, jaise Actual 90% par. Har condition recipients ko email aur action group trigger kar sakti hai, jo webhook, Logic App ya runbook call kar sakta hai. Policy, locks aur Advisor budget ke muqable kharcha track nahi karte.

D1-195.q: Kaun sa tool paise bachane ke liye kam use hone wali VMs ko resize ya band karne jaisi recommendations deta hai?
D1-195.exp: Azure Advisor ki Cost recommendations idle ya kam use hone wale resources dhoondti hain, VMs resize ya band karne ki salah deti hain, aur reservations recommend karti hain. Policy rules enforce karti hai, Network Watcher networking diagnose karta hai, aur Service Health Azure incidents report karta hai.

D1-196.q: Azure Advisor kin categories mein recommendations deta hai?
opts: Cost, Security, Reliability, Operational excellence, Performance
Identity, Compliance, Networking, Licensing aur Data protection
D1-196.exp: Azure Advisor paanch categories mein recommendations deta hai: Reliability, Security, Performance, Cost aur Operational Excellence — jo Azure Well-Architected Framework ke pillars hain. Yeh sirf cost aur security tak mehdood nahi.

D1-197.q: Ek VM agle teen saal 24/7 ek hi size par chalegi. Kaun sa option compute cost sab se zyada kam karta hai?
opts: Azure Spot VMs, deallocate eviction policy ke sath
D1-197.exp: 3 saal ka reserved instance hamesha ek size par chalne wali VM ke liye sab se bari discount deta hai. Pay-as-you-go sab se mehnga hai, Spot VMs kabhi bhi evict ho sakti hain (24/7 kaam ke liye munasib nahi), aur bari VM zyada mehngi hai.

D1-198.q: Aap Software Assurance wale mojooda on-premises Windows Server licenses ko Azure VMs par dobara use karna chahte hain. Kaun sa benefit?
D1-198.exp: Azure Hybrid Benefit Software Assurance wale mojooda Windows Server (ya SQL Server) licences ko Azure VMs par use karne deta hai, is liye aap sirf base compute rate dete hain. Reserved instances 1 ya 3 saal ke commitment par compute sasta karte hain, aur Spot aur Dev/Test alag pricing options hain.

D1-199.q: Deploy karne se pehle aap ko 3 VMs aur ek storage account ki monthly cost ka andaza lagana hai. Kaun sa tool?
D1-199.exp: Azure pricing calculator un services ki cost ka andaza lagata hai jo aap deploy karne wale hain, jaise 3 VMs aur ek storage account. TCO calculator on-premises costs ka Azure se muqabla karta hai, aur Cost analysis aur Advisor pehle se mojood resources par kaam karte hain.

D1-200.ctx: MG-Root → MG-Prod → Sub-Prod → RG-Web (tag env=prod) → WebApp1. Policy 'Inherit tag env from resource group' (Modify) MG-Prod par assigned hai. Bob ke paas MG-Root par Reader hai. RG-Web par ReadOnly lock hai.
D1-200.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: RG-Web mein banne wali nayi App Service ko khud env=prod mil jata hai
Bob WebApp1 dekh sakta hai
Sub-Prod ka Owner lock hataye baghair WebApp1 ki app settings badal sakta hai
Sub-Prod ko doosre MG ke neeche move karne se us ke resources se inherited policy hat jati hai
D1-200.exp: ReadOnly lock RG-Web mein nayi App Service banana block karta hai, is liye kuch tag nahi hota; Reader root se inherit hota hai; ReadOnly Owner ke liye bhi writes block karta hai; policy hierarchy mein jagah ke sath chalti hai, is liye subscription ko MG-Prod se bahar le jane se woh hat jati hai.

D1-241.q: User1 ke paas RG1 par Contributor hai. RG1 ki VM1 par ReadOnly lock hai. Kya User1 VM1 restart kar sakta hai?
opts: Haan, kyunke Contributor mein restart action shamil hai
Haan, kyunke locks sirf delete aur resize rokte hain
Nahi, kyunke restart POST action hai jisay lock rokta hai
Nahi, kyunke sirf Owner VM restart kar sakta hai
D1-241.exp: Contributor restart action deta hai, lekin ReadOnly lock control plane par sirf read operations allow karta hai. Restart POST action hai, is liye lock hatne tak sab ke liye, Owner samet, band hai.

D1-242.q: User1 RG1 ka Owner hai. Ek deployment stack ne RG1 ki VM1 par write actions wala deny assignment banaya hai. User1 VM1 resize karta hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Resize ho jayega, kyunke Owner deny assignments par bhari hai
Resize fail hoga, kyunke deny assignments pehle dekhe jate hain
Resize ho jayega, kyunke deny assignments sirf data actions par hain
Resize fail hoga jab tak User1 ko Contributor bhi na mile
D1-242.exp: Azure role assignments se pehle deny assignments dekhta hai. Koi lagta ho to access band hai, user ke roles jo bhi hon. Doosra role dene se faida nahi: deny assignment (yahan stack ki deny settings) badalna hoga.

D1-243.q: User1 ke paas RG1 par custom role hai: Actions "Microsoft.Compute/*", NotActions "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/delete". User1 ke paas subscription par Virtual Machine Contributor bhi hai. Kya User1 RG1 ki VM1 delete kar sakta hai?
opts: Nahi, kyunke qareebi scope ka NotActions jeetta hai
Nahi, kyunke NotActions us user ke liye deny hai
Haan, kyunke doosra role delete action deta hai
Haan, lekin sirf subscription ke page se
D1-243.exp: Azure RBAC additive hai: effective permissions tamam role assignments ka majmua hain. NotActions sirf usi ek role se action nikalta hai. Virtual Machine Contributor delete deta hai aur RG1 ko inherit hota hai, is liye delete allowed hai.

D1-244.q: User1 ko Azure portal mein Entra ID se sign in kar ke ek container mein blobs upload karne hain. User1 ko kaun se assignments chahiye?
opts: Container par Storage Blob Data Contributor, aur account tak jane ke liye Reader
Account par Storage Account Contributor, aur list keys ki permission
Resource group aur account par Reader
D1-244.exp: Blob upload data action hai, is liye Storage Blob Data Contributor jaisa data role chahiye, least privilege ke liye container scope par. Portal ko account dikhana bhi hota hai, jis ke liye Reader chahiye. Contributor aur Storage Account Contributor mein blob data actions nahi.

D1-245.q: GroupA ke paas management group MG1 par Contributor hai. User1 GroupA mein hai aur MG1 ke neeche RG1 par seedha Reader bhi hai. User1 ko GroupA se nikal diya jata hai. Kya access bachta hai?
opts: MG1 ke har resource par Reader
Agle sign-in tak koi access nahi
D1-245.exp: Group ki permissions sirf membership tak rehti hain. Nikalne ke baad sirf RG1 par seedha Reader bachta hai, aur woh doosre resource groups tak nahi jata. Role ki tabdeeli mein chand minute lag sakte hain.

D1-246.q: User1 ke paas sirf yeh assignments hain: Sub1 par Reader, aur RG1 (Sub1 mein) par Virtual Machine Contributor. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: User1 RG1 ki VM start kar sakta hai
User1 RG2 ki VM start kar sakta hai
User1 RG2 ka storage account dekh sakta hai
User1 User2 ko RG1 par Reader role de sakta hai
D1-246.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor se VMs start hoti hain, lekin sirf RG1 mein. Subscription ka Reader har resource group ko inherit hota hai, is liye RG2 ke resources dikhte hain, badalte nahi. Dono roles role assign nahi kar sakte: us ke liye Owner ya User Access Administrator chahiye.

D1-247.q: Global Administrator, jis ke paas koi Azure role nahi, "Access management for Azure resources" on karta hai. Woh foran har subscription mein kya kar sakta hai?
opts: Koi bhi resource bana aur delete kar sakta hai
Azure roles assign kar sakta hai, khud ko bhi
Kisi bhi storage account ka blob data parh sakta hai
Subscription Owner ki approval tak kuch nahi
D1-247.exp: Elevate access root scope (/) par User Access Administrator role deta hai. Is se woh tamam subscriptions mein resources dekh aur roles assign kar sakta hai, lekin munasib role khud ko diye baghair resources nahi bana sakta. Kaam ke baad setting band karni chahiye.

D1-248.q: GroupA ke paas RG1 par Reader hai. GroupB GroupA ka member hai. User1 sirf GroupB ka member hai. User1 kya kar sakta hai?
opts: RG1 ke resources dekh sakta hai, kyunke role assignments groups mein transitive hain
Kuch nahi, kyunke role assignments nested groups ke members tak nahi jate
RG1 tab dekhega jab GroupB ko seedha Reader mile
RG1 tab dekhega jab dono groups dynamic hon
D1-248.exp: Role assignments groups ke liye transitive hain: nested group ke member ko parent group ki permissions milti hain. Isay group-based licensing se na milayen, jo nested groups tak nahi jati.

D1-249.q: st1 par storage account key access (shared key) band hai. User1 ke paas st1 par Contributor hai aur woh portal mein container kholta hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Blobs account key se list ho jayenge
Blob data ka access deny hoga
Blobs list honge, lekin download fail hoga
D1-249.exp: Contributor aam tor par portal ko account keys lene deta hai jin se data parha jata hai. Shared key access band ho to keys kaam nahi karti, aur Contributor mein blob data actions nahi, is liye access deny hota hai. User1 ko Storage Blob Data Reader jaisa role chahiye.

D1-250.q: VM1 RG1 mein hai, RG1 Sub1 mein, aur Sub1 MG1 ke neeche. Kaun se DO assignments akele hi User1 ko VM1 restart karne dete hain?
D1-250.exp: Assignment apne scope aur us se neeche kaam karta hai, is liye MG1 par Virtual Machine Contributor VM1 tak pahunchta hai, aur VM1 par seedha Contributor bhi. RG2 ka role RG1 tak nahi jata, aur Reader VM restart nahi kar sakta.

D1-251.q: PIM ke sath eligible Azure role assignment kis scope par NAHI ban sakta?
D1-251.exp: Eligible assignments management group, subscription aur resource group scope par bante hain, resource scope par nahi. Un ke liye Microsoft Entra ID P2 ya Entra ID Governance license chahiye.

D1-252.q: Ek automation service principal aur ek administrator dono ko RG1 par Contributor chahiye. Administrator ko sirf zaroorat par mile. Aap kya banayenge?
opts: Administrator ke liye eligible aur service principal ke liye active assignment
Administrator ke liye active aur service principal ke liye eligible assignment
Dono ke liye time-bound deny assignment
D1-252.exp: Eligible assignments sirf users ke liye hain: service principal ya managed identity role activate nahi kar sakti. Is liye administrator ko eligible milta hai jisay woh zaroorat par activate kare, aur service principal ko active.

D1-253.q: User1 ke paas RG1 par eligible Contributor assignment hai aur koi doosra role nahi. User1 RG1 ki VM stop karta hai aur authorization error aata hai. Kyun?
opts: Eligible users sirf resources parh sakte hain
User1 ne abhi role activate nahi kiya
Contributor VM stop nahi kar sakta
Eligible assignments sirf VM scope par chalte hain
D1-253.exp: Eligible assignment activate hone tak koi permission nahi deta, aur activate karne mein MFA, wajah ya approval lag sakti hai. Activate hone par access active Contributor jaisa hi hota hai, activation khatam hone tak.

D1-254.q: Users sirf woh blobs parhein jin par blob index tag Project=Alpha ho. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Doosre tags ke liye NotDataActions wala custom role
Storage Blob Data Reader par role assignment condition
D1-254.exp: Azure ABAC se blob data actions wale role assignment par condition lagti hai, maslan "sirf tab read allow ho jab blob index tag Project Alpha ho". NotDataActions tags nahi dekhta, aur Policy aur locks tay nahi karte ke blob data kaun parhe.

D1-255.q: User1 ke paas st1 par Storage Blob Data Reader hai, sirf Project=Alpha blobs ki condition ke sath. User1 ko st1 par baghair condition ke bhi Storage Blob Data Reader mil jata hai. User1 kya parh sakta hai?
opts: Sirf Project=Alpha blobs, kyunke condition jeetti hai
Koi blob nahi, kyunke assignments takrate hain
Tamam blobs, kyunke role assignments jama hote hain
Sirf woh blobs jin par index tags nahi
D1-255.exp: Condition sirf apne assignment ko mehdood karti hai. Woh access deny nahi kar sakti, is liye usi scope par baghair condition wala assignment sab kuch deta hai. Filter lagane ke liye woh assignment hatayen.

D1-256.q: In mein se kis role assignment par ABAC condition lag sakti hai?
opts: st1 par Storage Blob Data Contributor
D1-256.exp: Conditions sirf un role assignments par lagti hain jin ke role mein blob ya queue data actions hon, jaise Storage Blob Data Contributor. Baqi teen roles control plane par resources manage karte hain.

D1-257.q: Har subscription mein env=prod tag wale resources koi delete na kar sake, lekin admins unhein badal saken. Kam mehnat mein sab se munasib kya hai?
opts: Management group par denyAction effect wali Azure Policy
Management group par Deny effect wali Azure Policy
Har admin ke liye delete actions ke baghair custom role
D1-257.exp: denyAction effect policy rule (jaise tag) se match hone wale resources ki delete calls rokta hai, aur management group par ek assignment tamam subscriptions cover karta hai. Subscription lock har delete rokega, Deny create aur update par hai, aur custom roles Owners ko nahi rokte.

D1-258.q: denyAction effect wali policy VM1 ki hifazat karti hai. Owner Azure CLI se VM1 delete karta hai. Nateeja kya hai?
opts: VM1 delete ho kar non-compliant mark hoti hai
Request 403 Forbidden ke sath fail hoti hai
VM1 band ho kar 14 din rakhi jati hai
Request approval ka intezar karti hai
D1-258.exp: denyAction delete request rok kar 403 Forbidden deta hai, caller ka role jo bhi ho. Audit delete hone deta aur sirf record karta. Policy mein soft delete ya approval ka step nahi.

D1-259.q: denyAction policy effect ke bare mein kaun se DO statements sahi hain?
opts: Yeh sirf delete action rok sakta hai
Yeh matching resources ki tabdeeliyan bhi rokta hai
Yeh subscription ka delete nahi rokta
Yeh mojooda role assignments hatata hai
D1-259.exp: denyAction sirf delete action support karta hai, aur subscription delete karna is se nahi rukta. Resource ki tabdeeli allowed rehti hai: us ke liye Deny effect ya ReadOnly lock. Policy role assignments nahi badalti.

D1-260.q: MG1 par Allowed locations policy hai (Deny, sirf West Europe), jis mein RG1 excluded hai. Owner RG1 mein East US ka storage account deploy karta hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Deployment kamyab hogi, kyunke RG1 excluded hai
Deployment fail hogi, kyunke exclusions Owners par nahi lagti
Deployment kamyab hogi, aur account West Europe mein move hoga
Deployment fail hogi, kyunke management group ki policy mein exclusion nahi hoti
D1-260.exp: Excluded scope evaluate nahi hota, is liye RG1 mein Allowed locations policy nahi lagti aur sahi role wale ki deployment ho jati hai. RG1 ke bahar yeh policy Owner ko bhi rokti. Policy resources move nahi karti.

D1-261.q: RG1 par ReadOnly lock hai. Modify policy ki remediation task ko RG1 ke resources par tag lagana hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Tags lag jayenge, kyunke policy locks se bahar chalti hai
Task fail hogi, kyunke lock write operations rokta hai
Lock ke CanNotDelete banne ke baad tags lag jayenge
Task lock delete kar ke tags lagati hai
D1-261.exp: Remediation assignment ki managed identity se resources par likhti hai, aur ReadOnly lock har identity ki control-plane write rokta hai. Task chalane se pehle lock hatayen (ya CanNotDelete karein, jo update allow karta hai).

D1-262.q: Aaj aap "Inherit a tag from the resource group" policy (Modify) assign karte hain. VM1 pehle se RG1 mein us tag ke baghair hai. RG1 par tag hai. VM1 ko tag kab milega?
opts: Remediation task chalne ya VM1 update hone par
Agli 24 ghante wali evaluation par, baghair task
Kabhi nahi, kyunke Modify sirf naye resources par hai
D1-262.exp: Modify resources ko create ya update hone par badalta hai. Pehle se mojood resources ke liye remediation task chalate hain. Rozana evaluation sirf compliance batati hai, kuch badalti nahi.

D1-263.q: RG1 ki VM1 par CanNotDelete lock hai. RG1 par khud koi lock nahi. Owner RG1 delete karta hai. Kya hoga?
opts: RG1 aur us ka sab kuch delete ho jata hai
VM1 ke siwa sab delete ho kar RG1 ka naam badal jata hai
Locked resource ki wajah se RG1 ka delete fail hota hai
VM1 pehle doosre resource group mein move hoti hai
D1-263.exp: Resource group delete karne mein us ka har resource delete hota hai. Ek par CanNotDelete lock yeh rok deta hai, is liye lock hatne tak group delete nahi hota. Locks Owner par bhi lagte hain.

D1-264.q: Sub1 par do policies hain: Modify jo costcenter=100 tag lagati hai, aur Deny jo costcenter tag lazmi karti hai. User baghair tag VM banata hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Banana deny hoga, kyunke Deny pehle chalta hai
VM costcenter=100 ke sath ban jayegi
VM baghair tag banegi aur audit hogi
Policies takrati hain, is liye koi nahi lagti
D1-264.exp: Create request mein Modify aur Append Deny se pehle evaluate hote hain. Request mein tag lag jata hai, is liye Deny policy ko tag wali VM nazar aati hai aur woh guzarne deti hai. Policies ka takrao nazar-andaz nahi hota: nateeja cumulative hota hai.

D1-265.q: VM1 ki policy exemption ki expiration date aa jati hai. Policy ka effect Audit hai. VM1 ka kya hoga?
opts: Dobara evaluate hogi aur non-compliant dikh sakti hai
Jab tak koi exemption delete na kare Exempt rahegi
D1-265.exp: Expiration ke baad exemption nahi mani jati, halanke object record ke liye rehta hai. VM1 baqi resources ki tarah evaluate hoti hai aur rule tore to non-compliant dikhti hai. Audit kuch band ya delete nahi karta.

D1-266.q: Sub1 par public IP addresses deny karne wali policy hai, RG1 excluded hai. RG2 mein pehle se ek public IP hai. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Contributor RG1 mein public IP bana sakta hai
Owner RG2 mein public IP bana sakta hai
RG2 ka mojooda public IP delete hota hai
RG2 ka mojooda public IP non-compliant dikhta hai
D1-266.exp: RG1 excluded hai, is liye wahan policy nahi lagti. RG2 mein Deny sab ke liye banana rokta hai, Owner samet. Deny mojooda cheezon ko nahi chherta: purana public IP chalta rehta hai aur non-compliant dikhta hai.

D1-267.q: Aap VM1 ko RG1 se RG2 mein move karte hain. RG1 par ReadOnly lock hai. Aap dono ke Owner hain. Kya hoga?
opts: Move kamyab, kyunke aap dono ke Owner hain
Move fail, kyunke source ka lock rokta hai
Move kamyab, aur lock VM1 ke sath chala jata hai
Move fail, kyunke VMs resource group nahi badalti
D1-267.exp: Move source group ko badalta hai, aur ReadOnly lock sirf read allow karta hai, is liye Owner ke liye bhi band hai. Lock hatayen, VM aur us ke dependent resources move karein, phir lock lagayen. Aam halat mein VM groups ke darmiyan move hoti hai.

D1-268.q: Storage account st1 par ReadOnly lock hai. User1 ke paas Storage Blob Data Contributor hai aur woh Entra ID sign-in se blob upload karta hai. Kya hoga?
opts: Upload fail, kyunke lock writes rokta hai
Upload ho jayega, kyunke locks sirf control plane par hain
Upload ho jayega, lekin blob read-only ban jayega
Upload fail, kyunke keys list nahi ho sakti
D1-268.exp: Locks control-plane operations par lagte hain, data par nahi. Entra ID se authorized upload data-plane hai, is liye chalta hai. Account keys mangne wale tools fail honge, kyunke keys list karna control-plane POST action hai.

D1-269.q: MG1 par Deny policy aur GroupA ka Reader assignment hai. MG2 par dono nahi. Aap Sub1 ko MG1 se MG2 mein move karte hain. Baad mein kya sahi hai?
opts: Policy aur Reader access Sub1 ke sath rehte hain
Na policy na Reader access Sub1 par lagta hai
Sirf policy rehti hai, kyunke evaluate ho chuki thi
Sirf Reader access rehta hai, kyunke roles copy hote hain
D1-269.exp: Policy aur role assignments mojooda parent management group se inherit hote hain. Woh subscription mein copy nahi hote, is liye move ke baad Sub1 ko sirf MG2 aur us se upar walon ka milta hai.

D1-270.q: Aap purani apps Azure VMs par le ja rahe hain. Unhein domain join, LDAP aur Kerberos chahiye. Domain controllers chalana ya patch karna nahi chahte. Kya use karenge?
opts: Entra join ke sath Microsoft Entra ID
Do Azure VMs par AD DS
D1-270.exp: Microsoft Entra Domain Services managed domain hai: domain join, group policy, LDAP aur Kerberos/NTLM, aur domain controllers Microsoft chalata hai. Entra ID mein LDAP ya Kerberos domain join nahi, VMs par AD DS mein controllers khud sambhalne parte hain, aur Entra Connect sirf identities sync karta hai.

D1-271.q: Khud chalaye AD DS ke muqable mein Microsoft Entra Domain Services ki kaun si DO hadein hain?
opts: VMs domain join nahi kar sakti
Domain administrator ke haq nahi milte
D1-271.exp: Managed domain AD DS ka ek hissa deta hai: domain join, group policy, LDAP aur Kerberos chalte hain, lekin schema extension nahi aur Domain Admin ya Enterprise Admin haq nahi, kyunke controllers Microsoft chalata hai.

D1-272.q: Har description ko identity service se match karein.
items: Domain controllers aap khud deploy aur patch karte hain
Microsoft 365 aur SaaS apps ka sign-in
VMs ke liye group policy aur Kerberos wala managed domain
D1-272.exp: Entra Domain Services managed domain hai. AD DS woh directory hai jo aap apne servers ya VMs par chalate hain. Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft 365, SaaS apps aur Azure portal ki cloud identity service hai.

D1-273.q: Employees ke accounts on-premises AD DS mein hain. Unhein Microsoft 365 ke liye wahi identity chahiye, aur accounts on-premises hi banenge. Aap kya set karenge?
opts: AD DS se Microsoft Entra ID tak synchronization
VNet mein Microsoft Entra Domain Services
D1-273.exp: AD DS ko Microsoft Entra ID se sync karne par har employee ki ek hybrid identity hoti hai jis ka asal source on-premises rehta hai. Cloud-only accounts alag identities hote, Domain Services Azure ke domain-joined workloads ke liye hai, aur tenant tak VPN se nahi jate.

D1-274.q: Microsoft Entra ID ke bare mein Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: AD DS ki tarah OUs aur group policy use karta hai
Apps isay OAuth 2.0 aur SAML jaise protocols se use kar sakti hain
Isay LDAP se query kiya ja sakta hai
Yeh on-premises AD DS se sync ho sakta hai
D1-274.exp: Entra ID flat, web-based identity service hai: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect aur SAML jaise HTTP protocols, aur LDAP ki jagah Microsoft Graph. Is mein OUs ya group policy nahi. Yeh on-premises AD DS se sync ho sakta hai.

D1-275.q: 60 subscriptions, aur aane wali har subscription, mein sirf approved VM sizes allow hon. Sab se kam administrative mehnat kis mein hai?
opts: Script se har subscription par policy assign karein
Policy aise management group par assign karein jis mein nayi subscriptions default aati hain
Har subscription mein har VM admin ko custom role dein
Har resource group par policy assign karein aur har template mein dalein
D1-275.exp: Management group ki policy us ki tamam subscriptions ko inherit hoti hai, aur usay nayi subscriptions ka default banane se aane wali bhi cover hoti hain. Script har nayi subscription par dobara chalani parti hai, aur roles VM size mehdood nahi karte.

D1-276.q: Helpdesk staff RG1 ki VMs dekh aur restart kar sake, is se zyada kuch nahi. Least privilege kis assignment mein hai?
opts: Read aur restart actions wala custom role, RG1 par assign
Microsoft.Compute/* wala custom role, subscription par assign
D1-276.exp: Virtual Machine Contributor se woh VMs bana, resize aur delete bhi kar sakte. Sirf Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/read aur .../restart/action (aur group par read) wala custom role, RG1 par, theek utna hi deta hai, sab se chhote scope par.

D1-277.q: Sales department mein aane jane wale users ke sath licenses khud lagein aur hatein. Sab se kam administrative mehnat kis mein hai?
opts: Department rule wale dynamic group ko licenses dein
Mahana script se har user ko licenses dein
Assigned group ko licenses dein aur members haath se badlein
Azure subscription ke IAM page mein licenses dein
D1-277.exp: Dynamic group department attribute se users add aur remove karta hai, aur group-based licensing membership ke sath license deti ya leti hai. Scripts aur haath ke groups mein baar baar kaam hai, aur licenses Azure IAM mein nahi lagte. Dynamic groups ko Entra ID P1 chahiye.

D1-278.q: Development subscription ka kharcha budget ke 100% par pahunche to us ki VMs khud deallocate hon. Sab se kam administrative mehnat kis mein hai?
opts: Sirf budget, kyunke kharcha 100% hone par woh tamam resources band karta hai
Budget alert, jis ka action group Automation runbook chalaye
VM banane par Deny effect wali Azure Policy
ReadOnly lock jo Cost Management 100% par lagaye
D1-278.exp: Budget sirf khabar deta hai. Us ka alert aise action group se jorein jo VMs deallocate karne wala runbook (ya function) chalaye, to haath ka kaam nahi. Deny policy chalti VMs ko nahi chherti, aur Cost Management locks nahi lagata.

D1-279.ctx: Aap ki subscription mein development VMs hain. Koi bhi, subscription Owners samet, Standard_B2ms se bari VM na bana sake.
D1-279.q: Hal: Aap subscription par ReadOnly lock lagate hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D1-279.exp: ReadOnly lock subscription mein har tabdeeli rokega, allowed choti VMs banana aur VMs start ya stop karna bhi, is liye sirf size mehdood karne ka maqsad poora nahi hota. Allowed virtual machine size SKUs policy karti hai.

D1-280.ctx: Aap ki subscription mein development VMs hain. Koi bhi, subscription Owners samet, Standard_B2ms se bari VM na bana sake.
D1-280.q: Hal: Aap subscription par built-in policy "Allowed virtual machine size SKUs" approved sizes ke sath assign karte hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D1-280.exp: Policy un VMs ko deny karti hai jin ka size approved list mein nahi, aur Azure Policy sab par lagti hai, Owner samet, role jo bhi ho. Mojooda bari VMs nahi hatti, lekin non-compliant dikhti hain.

D1-281.ctx: Aap ki subscription mein development VMs hain. Koi bhi, subscription Owners samet, Standard_B2ms se bari VM na bana sake.
D1-281.q: Hal: Aap developers ke liye VM banane ki ijazat wala custom role banate aur subscription par assign karte hain. Kya yeh maqsad poora karta hai?
D1-281.exp: Role tay karta hai ke shakhs kaun se actions kare, VM ka size nahi, aur Owners ko to bilkul mehdood nahi karta. Resources kaise hon, yeh Azure Policy ka kaam hai.

D1-282.q: Role assignments dekhein. RG1 aur RG2 Sub1 mein hain. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Ali RG1 ki VM restart kar sakta hai
Ali RG2 ke resources dekh sakta hai
Sara RG2 mein VM bana sakti hai
Sara khud ko RG2 par Contributor bana sakti hai
D1-282.exp: Ali GroupOps ke zariye RG1 ki VMs restart karta hai aur Sub1 ke Reader se RG2 dekhta hai. User Access Administrator se Sara RG2 ka access manage karti hai, wahan resources nahi banati. Access manage kar sakti hai to khud ko Contributor bhi de sakti hai, is liye yeh role ehtiyat se dein.

D1-283.q: Policy compliance page dekhein. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: 10 non-compliant resources chalte rehte hain
RG-App mein baghair tag VM banana block hai
RG-Lab mein baghair tag VM banana block hai
Owner RG-App mein baghair tag VM bana sakta hai
D1-283.exp: Deny sirf naye aur update hone wale resources par hai, is liye 10 mojooda chalte rehte aur report hote hain. RG-App mein baghair tag VM sab ke liye block hai. RG-Lab excluded hai, is liye evaluate nahi hota.

D1-284.q: vm1 aur vm2 RG1 mein hain. Locks dekhein. Haan ya Nahi:
stmts: Aap vm2 resize kar sakte hain
Aap vm2 delete kar sakte hain
Aap vm1 start kar sakte hain
RG1 ka Contributor locks hata sakta hai
D1-284.exp: vm2 ko sirf CanNotDelete inherit hota hai, is liye badal sakti hai, delete nahi. vm1 par ReadOnly bhi hai, aur sab se sakht lock jeetta hai, is liye start (POST action) band hai. Locks ke liye Owner ya User Access Administrator chahiye.
